cons: 摘要未充分交代训练与推理额外成本、统计显著性及与更强基线的公平对比，泛化与稳健性风险仍在

papers.title_zh: DStill：用于块扩散推测解码中加速一步起草的轨迹一致性蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 块扩散推测解码通过并行起草多个标记来加速大型语言模型推理。然而，离散扩散中的一步起草受到令牌分解误差的限制：每个令牌都是从同一屏蔽块预测的，而不以该步骤中其他位置选择的令牌为条件。这可能会产生不一致的草稿并缩短验收时间。迭代细化通过对先前提交的令牌进行后续预测来缓解这一限制，尽管额外的传递会增加起草成本。为了解决草稿保真度和推理延迟之间的这种权衡，我们引入了 DStill，这是一种两阶段框架，可将目标条件起草者自己的多步骤细化提炼为一步起草。我们首先训练绘图员完成部分显示的块，然后使用其细化轨迹来训练学生一次性预测最终完成情况。通过使用从部分输入逐渐过渡到完全屏蔽输入的课程，我们成功地将多步细化能力转化为一步。在三个模型系列的推理、数学和代码基准测试中，与单步 DFlash 相比，DStill 将接受长度提高了高达 28%，加速速度提高了 25%，与自回归解码相比，加速速度提高了高达 6.45 倍。

papers.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
papers.summary: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但学术增量与证据仍偏有限
pros: 将记忆内生到模型计算并给出可扩展存储机制，方向重要且贴近长期需求
在128K长上下文报告显著推理效率与存储收益，并兼顾通用能力保持
cons: 核心创新更偏架构整合与系统优化，理论新意和不可替代性尚不足
摘要未充分披露关键对照与统计显著性，严谨性与可复现性证据不够完整

papers.title_zh: MemT-1.0：迈向内存原生进化
papers.summary_zh: 记忆本机进化要求使记忆成为基础模型的内在能力，使它们能够不断积累和利用信息。为此，我们引入了 MemT-1.0，这是一种新的内存基础模型架构，它将内存内部化为模型计算的一部分。 MemT-1.0 基于 Metis 构建，采用门控 DeltaNet-2，每轮内具有稳定的令牌级内存更新机制。我们进一步引入混合存储来扩展本机内存容量。经过深思熟虑的主干准备后，我们开发了一个两阶段的训练管道，包括持续的预训练和后训练，并由 34B 代币的训练数据和高效的训练和推理基础设施支持。我们发布了MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash的型号系列，并对内存和通用能力进行了全面评估。结果表明，它们平均优于参数化记忆基线，并且与检索增强方法保持竞争力，同时在很大程度上保留了一般功能。在 128K 令牌的历史长度下，相对于完整上下文 KV 缓存，MemT-1.0-Nano 实现了约 1.86 美元\times$ 的端到端推理加速，并减少了 66\times$ 的持久存储。通过内化检索到的程序经验，MemT-1.0 提高了代理任务的成功率，为内存原生进化迈出了切实可行的一步。

papers.title: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs
papers.summary: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 面向移动端GUI代理的系统优化扎实且有实用价值。
pros: 问题选择贴近真实场景，兼顾时延、能耗与待机功耗三重目标
提出端到端运行时协同设计（检查点、推测解码、功耗管理），并在两代Snapdragon上给出可观收益
cons: 摘要未交代统计显著性、方差与更广基线，泛化性和可复现性证据仍偏有限

papers.title_zh: Tandem：在移动 NPU 上提供混合线性注意力 GUI 代理
papers.summary_zh: 智能手机 GUI 代理通过重复读取屏幕并询问模型下一步操作来完成移动应用程序中的任务。移动神经处理单元 (NPU) 支持本地执行，将屏幕内容保留在手机上，但模型延迟会随着每个操作而累积。混合线性注意力模型减少了内存需求，但重用其循环状态需要在适当的输入位置设置检查点。代理请求保留指令，但重写最近的历史记录，因此为聊天延续设计的检查点策略可能会错过可重用的前缀。保留推测解码的回滚状态还可以将即时处理移出 NPU 的矩阵单元，增加的开销超过了短动作输出上的解码节省。加载的模型可以进一步使 NPU 在任务之间保持唤醒状态。我们推出了 Tandem，这是移动 NPU 上混合 GUI 代理的运行时。 Tandem 保存连续提示发散的重复状态，允许后续请求重用先前处理的上下文。它将大部分预填充保留在矩阵单元上，并通过短的每个令牌尾部产生回滚状态。它的验证内核为所有提议的令牌读取每个权重块一次。在请求突发之间，Tandem 会释放 NPU 权力投票，而无需卸载模型。我们在 llama.cpp 中实现 Tandem，并根据记录的两代 Snapdragon 代理交互对其进行评估。在 Snapdragon 8 Elite 上，相对于 llama.cpp 最快的 NPU 配置，Tandem 将基于文本的屏幕描述的每步延迟降低了 30%，将屏幕截图的每步延迟降低了 16%，将每个文本步骤的能耗降低了 33%，并将模型负载的待机功耗从 0.76 W 降低到 0.22 W。

papers.title: ReAnchor: Reusing Rejected Verifier States for Diffusion Drafting
papers.summary: Block diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by generating multiple draft tokens in a single forward pass. However, each pass produces only a fixed-length block from a single target-generated anchor, limiting how far the draft can extend. Meanwhile, target verification computes hidden states even at positions beyond the first rejection, but these states are typically discarded rather than reused. We propose ReAnchor, a training-free method that reanchors a pretrained drafter at shifted positions using discarded verifier states to generate parallel draft blocks. These blocks improve predictions within the original block and extend coverage beyond its endpoint. At sampling temperature of T=0, ReAnchor achieves its largest average gains on Gemma 4-12B, improving acceptance length by 19.4% and decoding speed by 17.9% across eight benchmarks. Averaged equally over four target models and eight benchmarks, it improves acceptance length by 15.2% and decoding speed by 13.4% with pretrained DFlash drafters.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用且有效，但证据链仍需补强。
pros: 训练无关地复用被丢弃验证状态，工程落地门槛低
在多模型多基准上同时提升接受长度与端到端解码速度，收益幅度可观
cons: 摘要未交代额外并行草稿的计算/内存开销、不同温度与长上下文稳定性及统计显著性，严谨性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: ReAnchor：重用被拒绝的验证者状态进行扩散起草
papers.summary_zh: 块扩散起草者通过在单个前向传递中生成多个草案令牌来加速推测解码。然而，每次通过仅从单个目标生成的锚点生成固定长度的块，限制了草稿可以延伸的距离。同时，目标验证甚至在超出第一次拒绝的位置计算隐藏状态，但这些状态通常被丢弃而不是重用。我们提出了 ReAnchor，这是一种免训练方法，它使用丢弃的验证器状态将经过预训练的绘图器重新锚定在移动位置，以生成并行绘图块。这些块改进了原始块内的预测并将覆盖范围扩展到其端点之外。在 T=0 的采样温度下，ReAnchor 在 Gemma 4-12B 上实现了最大的平均增益，在八个基准测试中将接受长度提高了 19.4%，解码速度提高了 17.9%。通过对四个目标模型和八个基准进行平均计算，经过预训练的 DFlash 绘图器将接受长度提高了 15.2%，解码速度提高了 13.4%。

papers.title: ORBIT: Autoregressive Time Series Generation via Next Frequency-Band Prediction
papers.summary: Deep generative models provide an effective modern solution to alleviating the problem of data scarcity by synthesizing realistic time series. However, despite the considerable progress achieved by existing deep time series generators, two key challenges remain: (1) learning hierarchical representations for heterogeneous temporal patterns; and (2) coordinating the generation process of heterogeneous temporal dynamics. To address these key bottlenecks, in this work, we propose ORBIT, a unified deep generative framework for time series. Specifically, we develop two key components: the Frequency-Hierarchical VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) and the Frequency-Band Autoregressive Transformer (FBAR). The former learns hierarchical representations by decomposing latent temporal representations into different frequency bands and applying residual quantization with increasing token budgets. The latter establishes a novel low-to-high frequency autoregressive direction, yielding a time series generation process that first constructs global temporal structures and then incrementally incorporates fine-grained temporal details. These compact designs not only disentangle heterogeneous temporal patterns for more effective representation learning but also mitigate potential interference among different temporal dynamics during generation. Extensive experiments on multiple challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that ORBIT achieves state-of-the-art overall performance while exhibiting superior inference efficiency compared with advanced baselines.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 方向契合前沿，思路新颖但证据强度待验证。
pros: 提出按频带分层表征与低到高频自回归，机制设计有针对性
兼顾生成质量与推理效率诉求，若结果可信则具较高实用价值
cons: 仅凭摘要难确认SOTA与效率提升的统计显著性、泛化范围及公平对比充分性

papers.title_zh: ORBIT：通过下一个频段预测生成自回归时间序列
papers.summary_zh: 深度生成模型提供了一种有效的现代解决方案，通过合成现实时间序列来缓解数据稀缺问题。然而，尽管现有的深度时间序列生成器取得了相当大的进步，但仍然存在两个关键挑战：（1）学习异构时间模式的层次表示； (2)协调异质时间动态的生成过程。为了解决这些关键瓶颈，在这项工作中，我们提出了 ORBIT，一个统一的时间序列深度生成框架。具体来说，我们开发了两个关键组件：频率分层 VQ-VAE (FH-VQ-VAE) 和频段自回归变压器 (FBAR)。前者通过将潜在时间表示分解为不同的频带并通过增加令牌预算应用残差量化来学习分层表示。后者建立了一种新颖的从低频到高频的自回归方向，产生一个时间序列生成过程，该过程首先构建全局时间结构，然后逐步合并细粒度的时间细节。这些紧凑的设计不仅可以解开异构时间模式以实现更有效的表示学习，而且还可以减轻生成过程中不同时间动态之间的潜在干扰。对多个具有挑战性的现实世界基准进行的大量实验表明，ORBIT 实现了最先进的整体性能，同时与先进基准相比表现出卓越的推理效率。

papers.title: The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction
papers.summary: Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法新颖，证据尚需更严谨验证
pros: 抓住KV压缩中被忽视的软最大归一化耦合效应，问题定义到位
提出可闭式求解的二次代理与补偿机制，并在多任务多模型上宣称稳定提升
cons: 仅凭摘要仍缺关键细节：理论假设边界、校准数据敏感性与统计显著性未充分呈现

papers.title_zh: KV-Surgeon：补偿感知离线 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 键值缓存（KV-cache）的离线压缩通过构建一次较小的缓存并随后重用它来减少重复查询固定上下文的成本。压缩的核心挑战是决定删除哪些缓存条目以及保留哪些缓存条目。现有的方法对每个候选者进行单独的删除评分，而缓存的其余部分则保持固定。然而，注意力操作的 softmax 重整化以非线性方式耦合这些决策：删除一个条目会改变每个剩余条目的注意力权重。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 KV-Surgeon，它使用校准数据以易于处理的方式考虑相互作用。我们推导出一个二次代理，它允许封闭式表达式来共同做出最佳的贪婪删除决策以及剩余条目内的补偿​​。在 QuALITY、LongHealth 和 Long Code Arena 上，以及在每个评估的压缩比上，KV-Surgeon 都将密集模型和专家混合模型的成本精度帕累托前沿从 4B 大幅提升到了 30B 参数。在 $50\times$ 的压缩下，KV-Surgeon 的问答准确率比最先进的注意力匹配（Zweiger et al., 2026）提高了四个点，且成本相当。最后，我们引入了一种更快的变体，它也超越了现有技术，而成本仅为其五分之二。

papers.title: StreamAhead: Real-Time Streaming Video Question Answering via Adaptive Precomputation
papers.summary: Real-time streaming video question answering with vision-language models must answer queries that arrive at any time with low latency while sustaining the video-processing rate required by the application. Existing systems construct key-value (KV) caches for the entire video as it arrives, although a query typically uses only a few of the preceding frames as evidence. This highlights a fundamental trade-off: performing more computation as video arrives reduces query-time computation but can increase processing lag, whereas deferring computation can increase the video-processing rate but requires additional query-time computation for retrieved content. We present StreamAhead, an algorithm-system co-design that exploits this trade-off through adaptive precomputation: dynamically controlling how much computation to complete for each video segment before a query arrives. StreamAhead encodes video segments independently and lets each remain at a different representation level, from inexpensive visual features to costly KV caches, completing KV caches only for the retrieved segments when a query arrives. StreamAhead profiles offline the cost of advancing a segment to each representation level. Its runtime uses these profiles to schedule segment computation concurrently with query execution, pipelining it across heterogeneous CPU and GPU resources while maintaining the required video-processing rate. StreamAhead achieves accuracy competitive with state-of-the-art methods with up to 10.4x lower time-to-first-token (TTFT), and up to 5.9x lower TTFT than state-of-the-art streaming systems. It sustains 30 FPS with P95 TTFT under 0.5 s, and up to 57 FPS with P95 TTFT under 2 s. To our knowledge, StreamAhead is the first real-time streaming video QA system with competitive accuracy, setting a new Pareto frontier between video-processing rate and TTFT.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、系统设计巧妙，但证据完整性仍待加强。
pros: 抓住流式视频QA中预计算与查询时延的核心权衡，提出自适应分层表示思路有新意
报告了显著TTFT与吞吐收益，并给出P95时延与FPS指标，工程价值和可落地性较强

papers.title_zh: StreamAhead：通过自适应预计算进行实时流视频问答
papers.summary_zh: 使用视觉语言模型的实时流视频问答必须以低延迟回答随时到达的查询，同时维持应用程序所需的视频处理速率。尽管查询通常仅使用前面的几个帧作为证据，但现有系统会在整个视频到达时为其构建键值 (KV) 缓存。这凸显了一个基本的权衡：在视频到达时执行更多计算可以减少查询时间计算，但会增加处理延迟，而推迟计算可以提高视频处理速率，但需要对检索内容进行额外的查询时间计算。我们提出了 StreamAhead，这是一种算法系统协同设计，它通过自适应预计算来利用这种权衡：动态控制在查询到达之前每个视频片段要完成的计算量。 StreamAhead 独立编码视频片段，让每个片段保持不同的表示级别，从廉价的视觉特征到昂贵的 KV 缓存，仅在查询到达时为检索到的片段完成 KV 缓存。 StreamAhead 离线分析将分段推进到每个表示级别的成本。其运行时使用这些配置文件来同时调度分段计算和查询执行，跨异构 CPU 和 GPU 资源进行管道传输，同时保持所需的视频处理速率。 StreamAhead 的准确度可与最先进的方法相媲美，首次令牌时间 (TTFT) 比最先进的流系统低 10.4 倍，TTFT 低 5.9 倍。它可以在 0.5 秒内使用 P95 TTFT 维持 30 FPS，在 2 秒内使用 P95 TTFT 维持高达 57 FPS。据我们所知，StreamAhead 是第一个具有竞争精度的实时流视频 QA 系统，在视频处理速率和 TTFT 之间设定了新的帕累托前沿。

papers.title: System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache
papers.summary: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程思路实用，但证据链不足以支撑强结论

papers.title_zh: System X：从其自己的 KV 缓存进行回复的 LLM 决策模型
papers.summary_zh: 决策模型返回所提供选项的概率，但部署的代理可能还需要用文字回复。本研究介绍了 System X，这是一种大型语言模型 (LLM) 决策模型，它为 LLM-as-Jev 读数添加了文本回复选项。当此选项获胜或置信度较低时，相同的模型将从决策的键值 (KV) 缓存中继续，从而避免重复的提示预填充。 Qwen3-0.6B 已在 Reason-9k 和 Bittext 回复行上使用 LoRA 进行了微调。 JevBench 准确度没有显示出统计上的显着变化（55.4% 至 54.5%，p=0.87），而预期校准误差从 0.292 降至 0.169。 Held-out Bittext路由准确率达到98.3%。缓存重用可在 Apple M4 Pro 上节省 15-37% 的延迟，并且在 FP32 演示案例中具有令牌相同的回复。提示缓存副本上的评分选项与全序列评分匹配的概率在 1.4e-6 范围内。添加对话、行业和投诉数据 (System X+) 可改善支持任务结果，但将 IFEval 准确性从 55.5% 降低至 45.0%。 System X v4 使用 Qwen3-1.7B、重新平衡的数据和教师重写的回复目标。相对于其基础 LLM，JevBench 准确率从 55.0% 上升至 61.0% (p=0.04)，并且没有统计上显着的 IFEval 变化 (p=0.71)。对未适配的 Qwen3-1.7B 进行匹配延迟测试可节省 17-39%。一位 LLM 法官更喜欢 v4 回复，而不是未适应的 1.7B 第二次调用（31 对 11 对，p=0.003）；对方的偏好并不重要。这些回复比较在提示和生成限制方面也有所不同。状态冲突和不受支持的回复细节仍然是失败模式。建议对多个种子、人类评估者和真实支持数据进行进一步研究。

papers.title: MOSAIC: Multi-Objective Search for Allocating Inference Cache Across LLM Decoder Layers
papers.summary: The Key-Value (KV) cache is the main memory bottleneck of long-context LLM inference. Token eviction methods such as SnapKV, H2O, AdaKV and L2Norm shrink it, but they give every transformer layer the same budget, although layers differ in which tokens they need. We present MOSAIC, a multi-objective neural architecture search that learns per-layer KV-cache budgets for any eviction method. One search maps the trade-off between average budget and task score; its best allocation transfers to every target budget without further search, and an optional budget-constrained search refines it. Across four eviction methods on Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2, MOSAIC beats uniform allocation in 146 of 154 (task, method, budget) settings, by up to +48 points on RULER and +11.9 on LongBench (LCC). On both models, it reaches the score of uniform allocation with up to 4x less KV cache (75% smaller). Against EvolKV, MOSAIC explores a ~10^40 x larger search space with 4x fewer evaluations and 18% fewer GPU-hours per budget, and scores higher in 5 of 6 settings. The learned allocations consistently favour a small set of middle layers.

papers.title_zh: MOSAIC：跨 LLM 解码器层分配推理缓存的多目标搜索
papers.summary_zh: 键值（KV）缓存是长上下文LLM推理的主要内存瓶颈。 SnapKV、H2O、AdaKV 和 L2Norm 等令牌驱逐方法缩小了它，但它们为每个 Transformer 层提供了相同的预算，尽管各层所需的令牌有所不同。我们提出了 MOSAIC，一种多目标神经架构搜索，可以学习任何驱逐方法的每层 KV 缓存预算。一项搜索映射了平均预算和任务分数之间的权衡；其最佳分配无需进一步搜索即可转移到每个目标预算，并且可选的预算约束搜索对其进行细化。在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 上的四种驱逐方法中，MOSAIC 在 154 种（任务、方法、预算）设置中的 146 种中击败了统一分配，在 RULER 上高达 +48 点，在 LongBench (LCC) 上高达 +11.9 点。在这两种模型上，它都达到了统一分配的分数，KV 缓存减少了 4 倍（小了 75%）。与 EvolKV 相比，MOSAIC 探索了约 10^40 倍更大的搜索空间，评估次数减少了 4 倍，每个预算的 GPU 小时数减少了 18%，并且在 6 种设置中的 5 种中得分更高。学习到的分配始终有利于一小部分中间层。

papers.title: Improving the Expressive Power of Hybrid Sequence Models via Multi-Hop Retrieval
papers.summary: Hybrid architectures offer a promising approach to efficient language modeling by combining a small number of full-attention layers with a larger number of efficient sequence layers, such as sparse attention and recurrent layers. While full-attention layers maintain a KV cache that grows linearly with sequence length, efficient layers typically rely on separate, fixed-size states rather than accessing this richer existing memory. Recent work has begun exploring ways to allow efficient layers access to the KV cache, but the theoretical benefits of such access, and the extent to which existing approaches can realize them remain poorly understood. We investigate these questions by analyzing the expressive power of individual hybrid blocks on function composition, a well-studied task in sequence-model expressivity associated with multi-hop reasoning. We first establish that both conventional hybrid blocks and those with top-$κ$ KV-cache access require $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ capacity to compute even two-function composition over a domain of size $n$. To overcome this limitation, we introduce the \emph{Multi-hop Retrieval Attention} (MuRA) hybrid block, a simple architecture that enables multi-hop retrieval from a shared KV cache while preserving asymptotic computational and memory efficiency. We prove that a single fixed size $m$-hop MuRA block can compute $m$-function composition, whereas computing $(m+1)$-function composition with the same retrieval depth requires polynomial model size, establishing a strict expressivity hierarchy in retrieval depth. Synthetic experiments support this hierarchy, showing that increasing retrieval depth enables learning progressively deeper compositions, substantially outperforming existing hybrid architectures. Together, our results identify multi-hop retrieval as a promising mechanism for improving the expressive power of efficient hybrid architectures.

papers.title_zh: 通过多跳检索提高混合序列模型的表达能力
papers.summary_zh: 混合架构通过将少量全注意力层与大量有效序列层（例如稀疏注意力层和循环层）相结合，为高效语言建模提供了一种有前途的方法。虽然全注意力层维护一个随序列长度线性增长的 KV 缓存，但高效层通常依赖于单独的、固定大小的状态，而不是访问这种更丰富的现有内存。最近的工作已经开始探索允许有效层访问 KV 缓存的方法，但这种访问的理论上的好处以及现有方法可以在多大程度上实现它们仍然知之甚少。我们通过分析单个混合块对功能组合的表达能力来研究这些问题，这是与多跳推理相关的序列模型表达能力中经过充分研究的任务。我们首先确定传统的混合块和具有 top-$κ$ KV 缓存访问权限的混合块都需要 $Ω(\sqrt{n})$ 容量来计算大小为 $n$ 的域上的双函数组合。为了克服这一限制，我们引入了\emph{多跳检索注意}（MuRA）混合块，这是一种简单的架构，可以从共享 KV 缓存进行多跳检索，同时保持渐近计算和内存效率。我们证明单个固定大小的 $m$-hop MuRA 块可以计算 $m$-函数组合，而计算具有相同检索深度的 $(m+1)$-函数组合需要多项式模型大小，从而在检索深度中建立严格的表达层次结构。综合实验支持这种层次结构，表明增加检索深度可以逐渐学习更深的组合，大大优于现有的混合架构。总之，我们的结果表明多跳检索是一种有前途的机制，可以提高高效混合架构的表达能力。

papers.title: Conjugate Compilation: Self-Improving Agentic Co-Compilation for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: As LLM adoption surges, scaling model serving requires unlocking stranded GPU capacity alongside deploying more GPUs. Speculative decoding brings two models into the serving process: a small draft model proposes tokens that a larger target model verifies. Yet compiling these models individually leaves their shared execution outside the compiler's optimization boundary. We introduce CONJUGATE COMPILATION, which reframes speculative decoding as a cross-model compilation problem and jointly optimizes the draft and target models within their shared execution rather than treating each in isolation. Our key insight is that cross-model compilation should be informed by the measured performance of the co-located shared execution it produces: an optimization that improves a kernel in isolation need not improve the models when they execute together. To expand cross-model opportunities, we devise operand layouts that interleave blocks from both models within common tiles, co-locating GEMM and non-GEMM work while preserving their mathematics. We realize CONJUGATE COMPILATION through a self-improving agentic search system in which an LLM edits cross-model optimization plans using the compiler and GPU execution as its environment. Each proposed plan is compiled and evaluated through its co-located shared execution, whose measured score, together with kernel-level verdicts and compiler feedback, informs subsequent proposals, while Monte Carlo tree search accumulates rewards to guide exploration. Across six single-GPU speculative-decoding configurations on NVIDIA B300 and RTX 5090 GPUs, CONJUGATE COMPILATION achieves a geometric-mean per-round speedup of 1.37x over conventional execution. Interleaved kernels raise this speedup to 1.45x, reaching 1.59x in the best case. CONJUGATE COMPILATION also improves GPU utilization on average by 1.46x on RTX 5090 and 1.50x on B300.

papers.title_zh: 共轭编译：用于推测解码的自我改进代理协同编译
papers.summary_zh: 随着 LLM 采用率的激增，扩展模型服务需要释放闲置的 GPU 容量，同时部署更多 GPU。推测性解码将两个模型带入服务过程：一个小型草稿模型提出由较大目标模型验证的令牌。然而，单独编译这些模型会使它们的共享执行超出编译器的优化边界。我们引入了共轭编译，它将推测性解码重新构建为跨模型编译问题，并在共享执行中联合优化草稿模型和目标模型，而不是单独处理每个模型。我们的主要见解是，跨模型编译应该通过其产生的协同定位共享执行的测量性能来了解：单独改进内核的优化不需要在模型一起执行时改进模型。为了扩大跨模型机会，我们设计了操作数布局，将两个模型的块交错在公共块中，将 GEMM 和非 GEMM 工作放在一起，同时保留它们的数学。我们通过自我改进的代理搜索系统实现共轭编译，其中法学硕士使用编译器和 GPU 执行作为环境来编辑跨模型优化计划。每个提议的计划都是通过其协同定位的共享执行进行编译和评估的，其测量的分数与内核级判决和编译器反馈一起为后续提议提供信息，而蒙特卡洛树搜索则积累奖励以指导探索。在 NVIDIA B300 和 RTX 5090 GPU 上的六种单 GPU 推测解码配置中，共轭编译实现了比传统执行快 1.37 倍的几何平均每轮加速。交错内核将此加速提升至 1.45 倍，在最佳情况下达到 1.59 倍。CONJUGATE COMPILATION 还将 RTX 5090 上的 GPU 利用率平均提高了 1.46 倍，在 B300 上提高了 1.50 倍。

papers.title: ReTrace: Visual Backtracking for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) encode images into dense visual token sequences, creating substantial attention and KV-cache overhead. Existing visual token compression methods reduce this cost by pruning low-saliency tokens in shallow layers, but this practice couples temporary computational deactivation with irreversible information deletion. We show that this coupling breaks an intrinsic inference pattern in MLLMs. Through layer-wise attention analysis, we identify \textbf{Visual Backtracking}: visual pivots remain spatially stable, yet in middle layers they actively retrieve context from tokens that appeared unimportant earlier. Thus, early low-saliency tokens can be inactive for computation while still being useful for later reasoning. Motivated by this finding, we propose \textbf{ReTrace}, a backtracking-aware compression framework that introduces a dormant token state. ReTrace caches non-pivot tokens outside expensive layer-wise computation, restores them during the backtracking window, and prunes only after their information has been absorbed. Experiments on Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 demonstrate nearly 90\% reductions in FLOPs and KV cache, a 2.83$\times$ prefilling speedup, and strong performance retention across complex vision-language benchmarks.
papers.comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026, forthcoming

papers.title_zh: ReTrace：高效多模态大型语言模型的视觉回溯
papers.summary_zh: 多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 将图像编码为密集的视觉标记序列，从而产生大量的注意力和 KV 缓存开销。现有的视觉令牌压缩方法通过修剪浅层中的低显着性令牌来降低这种成本，但这种做法将临时计算停用与不可逆信息删除结合在一起。我们证明这种耦合打破了 MLLM 的内在推理模式。通过逐层注意力分析，我们识别出\textbf{视觉回溯}：视觉枢轴在空间上保持稳定，但在中间层中，它们主动从先前出现的不重要的标记中检索上下文。因此，早期的低显着性标记对于计算可能不活跃，但对于以后的推理仍然有用。受这一发现的启发，我们提出了 \textbf{ReTrace}，一个回溯感知的压缩框架，引入了休眠令牌状态。 ReTrace 在昂贵的逐层计算之外缓存非枢轴标记，在回溯窗口期间恢复它们，并且仅在吸收它们的信息后才进行修剪。 Qwen2.5-VL 和 InternVL3 上的实验表明，FLOP 和 KV 缓存减少了近 90%，预填充速度提高了 2.83$\times$，并且在复杂的视觉语言基准测试中具有强大的性能保留。

papers.title: When Does Better Acceptance Pay? A Controlled Study of Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: The throughput gains of speculative decoding depend on the trade-off between acceptance length and execution latency. We ask when additional acceptance is worth the cost of obtaining it. We establish a comparison protocol spanning training, inference, and evaluation, remeasuring released checkpoints and retraining six drafter recipes on shared target-generated data across ten benchmarks and two target models. Alignment changes the picture: gaps that appear large in published comparisons shrink substantially under shared training and inference conditions. This narrowing motivates two deeper questions: how is acceptance improved at different costs, and when do these gains improve throughput? We find that acceptance can be improved through nearly free objective and context changes or more expensive token-to-token conditioning. DCore illustrates the former route as a strong baseline with little additional measured drafting overhead. The payoff is conditional: task uncertainty and serving conditions affect acceptance returns, execution costs, and the preferred drafter and budget. These findings inform future drafter design and deployment choices.

papers.title_zh: 更好的接受何时会带来回报？推测解码的对照研究
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码的吞吐量增益取决于接受长度和执行延迟之间的权衡。我们询问额外的接受何时值得获得它的成本。我们建立了一个涵盖训练、推理和评估的比较协议，重新测量已发布的检查点，并根据十个基准和两个目标模型的共享目标生成数据重新训练六个起草者配方。一致性改变了情况：在已发表的比较中出现的巨大差距在共享训练和推理条件下大幅缩小。这种缩小引发了两个更深层次的问题：如何以不同的成本提高接受度，以及这些收益何时提高吞吐量？我们发现，可以通过几乎免费的目标和上下文改变或更昂贵的令牌到令牌条件来提高接受度。 DCore 将前一条路线说明为强大的基线，几乎没有额外测量的绘图开销。回报是有条件的：任务不确定性和服务条件会影响验收回报、执行成本以及首选起草人和预算。这些发现为未来的绘图仪设计和部署选择提供了信息。

papers.title: Certified Sparse Attention via Perturbed Retrieval
papers.summary: Sparse attention speeds up long-context decoding by reading few keys of the KV cache, but existing methods do not control the error of a query, and on real KV caches their errors have heavy tails. We show that perturbing the score of every key with an independent Exp(1) variable turns threshold retrieval into sampling keys with probability proportional to their attention weights. Lowering the threshold along a geometric grid gives nested samples, a Horvitz--Thompson estimate of the output at every level, and confidence bounds that hold simultaneously over all levels, so each head stops at the first level whose certificate meets the target error $\varepsilon$. With fresh perturbations at every decoding step, each certificate fails with probability at most $δ$ during generation. At a suitable threshold, the estimator reads $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$ values regardless of the context length, and no adaptive method reads fewer, up to constants. A 4-bit scan with deterministic bounds, shared across a grouped-query-attention group, generates the candidates exactly but reads every key. On three LLMs and ten settings at 16K--128K tokens, no certificate is violated, and at equal keys read our 90th-percentile error is 4.6--7.9$\times$ lower than that of the best of 15 baseline families. At equal bytes, the best baselines have 0.6--1.6 times our 90th-percentile error and at least 4.9 times our largest. End to end, our method stays within one point of dense attention on tasks and within 0.1\% in PG-19 perplexity, and the strongest baselines at equal bytes score as well. On CPU, decoding steps at 32K--128K tokens run 1.1--1.4$\times$ faster than dense attention on the same 16-bit cache.
papers.comment: 58 pages (10 pages main text, 48 pages appendix), 10 figures, 35 tables

papers.title_zh: 通过扰动检索认证稀疏注意力
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏注意力通过读取 KV 缓存的几个键来加速长上下文解码，但现有方法不能控制查询的错误，并且在真正的 KV 缓存上，它们的错误具有重尾。我们证明，用独立的 Exp(1) 变量扰动每个键的分数可以将阈值检索转变为采样键，其概率与其注意力权重成正比。沿着几何网格降低阈值会给出嵌套样本、每个级别输出的 Horvitz-Thompson 估计以及在所有级别上同时保持的置信界限，因此每个头都会停止在其证书满足目标误差 $\varepsilon$ 的第一个级别。由于每个解码步骤都有新的扰动，每个证书在生成过程中失败的概率最多为 $δ$。在合适的阈值下，无论上下文长度如何，估计器都会读取 $O(\varepsilon^{-2}\log(1/δ))$ 值，并且没有任何自适应方法读取的值会更少，最多可达常量。具有确定性边界的 4 位扫描，在分组查询注意力组中共享，可以准确生成候选值，但会读取每个键。在 16K--128K 令牌的三个 LLM 和 10 个设置上，没有违反任何证书，并且在相同的密钥下，我们的 90% 误差比 15 个基线系列中最好的误差低 4.6--7.9$\times$。在相同的字节数下，最佳基线的 90% 误差是我们的 0.6--1.6 倍，并且至少是最大误差的 4.9 倍。端到端，我们的方法对任务的集中注意力保持在 1 点以内，PG-19 困惑度保持在 0.1\% 以内，并且在相同字节分数上也保持最强基线。在 CPU 上，32K--128K 令牌的解码步骤比相同 16 位缓存上的密集注意力运行速度快 1.1--1.4$\times$。

papers.title: Accelerating CPU Speculative Decoding via Unified Graph Execution and Transactional KV Isolation
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference, but deploying it on CPUs introduces severe systems bottlenecks: context-swapping latency between draft and target graphs, and memory allocation overhead during KV cache rollbacks. We introduce SubTernary, an execution framework that eliminates these costs through Unified Graph Caching and Transactional KV-Cache Isolation. By compiling both models into a single memory arena with a persistent thread pool and routing speculative tokens to a static scratchpad for zero-copy pointer resets, SubTernary avoids dynamic reallocation and thread synchronization entirely. We integrate a 256-bit AVX2 ternary SIMD kernel as a low-bit case study. Ablations reveal our systems runtime drives 35.0% of the throughput gains, while the ternary kernel adds 6.0%. SubTernary achieves a $1.35\times$ speedup over llama.cpp speculative decoding and $3.99\times$ over autoregressive decoding, maintaining $O(1)$ rollback latency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程优化扎实，但理论与泛化证据仍不足。
pros: 精准抓住CPU投机解码的上下文切换与KV回滚瓶颈
统一图执行与事务化KV隔离结合，端到端加速和消融较完整
cons: 创新更偏系统工程整合，跨模型/跨硬件泛化与统计显著性证据在摘要中不足

papers.title_zh: 通过统一图执行和事务 KV 隔离加速 CPU 推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码可加速 LLM 推理，但将其部署在 CPU 上会带来严重的系统瓶颈：草稿图和目标图之间的上下文交换延迟，以及 KV 缓存回滚期间的内存分配开销。我们引入了 SubTernary，这是一个通过统一图缓存和事务 KV 缓存隔离消除这些成本的执行框架。通过将两个模型编译到具有持久线程池的单个内存区域中，并将推测令牌路由到静态暂存器以进行零复制指针重置，SubTernary 完全避免了动态重新分配和线程同步。我们集成了 256 位 AVX2 三进制 SIMD 内核作为低位案例研究。消融显示我们的系统运行时推动了 35.0% 的吞吐量增益，而三元内核则增加了 6.0%。 SubTernary 比 llama.cpp 推测解码实现了 $1.35\times$ 加速，比自回归解码实现了 $3.99\times$ 加速，同时保持了 $O(1)$ 回滚延迟。

papers.title: PV-Decoding: Progressive Verification Decoding with Decode Gating for Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer an attractive alternative to autoregressive generation by updating multiple tokens in parallel, but their inference efficiency is still limited by the cost of safely committing tentative predictions. In particular, speculative decoding for dLLMs is challenging because speculative tokens within the same diffusion block may depend on one another, making aggressive acceptance prone to error propagation and strict verification computationally expensive. We present PV-Decoding, a confidence-driven speculative decoding framework with progressive verification for block diffusion inference. PV-Decoding partitions masked positions into directly decoded tokens, speculative tokens, and unresolved tokens using two confidence thresholds, and then verifies speculative tokens with progressively stronger policies, including single-batch, dual-batch, and multi-batch verification. This design exposes a practical accuracy--efficiency trade-off: weaker verification minimizes overhead, whereas stronger verification improves acceptance precision and robustness. Experiments on three diffusion language models across GSM8K, MBPP, and HumanEval show that PV-Decoding reduces sequential model forward passes (MFPs) by 8%--37% relative to confidence-based decoding, while keeping the largest observed accuracy drop to 1.3%. On Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K, PV-Decoding (1-batch) and PV-Decoding (2-batch) improve throughput by 7.0%--13.6% under the same hardware budget, whereas PV-Decoding (multi-batch) is slower under the current runtime. These results suggest that confidence-guided speculation with structured verification is a practical path toward efficient and reliable dLLM inference.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路务实有效，但创新与证据强度中等。
pros: 针对dLLM推测解码依赖冲突提出渐进验证框架，问题定义清晰且工程导向强
给出多档验证策略与精度-效率权衡，并在多模型多任务上报告了稳定的MFP与吞吐收益

papers.title_zh: PV-解码：使用扩散语言模型的解码门控进行渐进验证解码
papers.summary_zh: 离散扩散语言模型（dLLM）通过并行更新多个标记，为自回归生成提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案，但其推理效率仍然受到安全提交尝试性预测的成本的限制。特别是，dLLM 的推测解码具有挑战性，因为同一扩散块内的推测令牌可能相互依赖，使得积极接受容易出现错误传播，并且严格验证的计算成本高昂。我们提出了 PV-Decoding，一种置信驱动的推测性解码框架，具有对块扩散推理的渐进验证。 PV-Decoding 使用两个置信度阈值将屏蔽位置划分为直接解码的令牌、推测性令牌和未解析的令牌，然后使用逐渐更强的策略来验证推测性令牌，包括单批次、双批次和多批次验证。该设计揭示了实际准确性与效率的权衡：较弱的验证可最大限度地减少开销，而较强的验证可提高验收精度和稳健性。对 GSM8K、MBPP 和 HumanEval 的三种扩散语言模型进行的实验表明，相对于基于置信度的解码，PV-Decoding 将顺序模型前向传递 (MFP) 减少了 8%--37%，同时将观察到的最大准确度下降保持在 1.3%。在 Dream-7B-Instruct/GSM8K 上，PV-Decoding (1-batch) 和 PV-Decoding (2-batch) 在相同硬件预算下将吞吐量提高了 7.0%--13.6%，而 PV-Decoding (multi-batch) 在当前运行时间下速度较慢。这些结果表明，带有结构化验证的置信引导推测是实现高效可靠的 dLLM 推理的实用途径。

papers.title: TideKV: Delayed KV Eviction via Layer-Wise Chunked Prefill for Memory-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
papers.summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. We present TideKV, an on-GPU cache-construction architecture using layer-major delayed eviction. TideKV processes all prompt chunks within each Transformer layer, retains full-prompt KV only for the active layer, and evicts at layer end. This schedule preserves full-prompt-aware selection while reducing activation and temporary memory. Experiments across multiple computing platforms show that TideKV preserves the inference quality and final cache size of the evaluated compression methods. At 64K on A100, it reduces the construction-time transient footprint by 83.89%. On RTX 4090, it increases time to first token by only 1.06% at 64K and enables 128K prefill. TideKV also completes 128K on Jetson, whereas matched post-prefill compression runs out of memory on both resource-constrained platforms. These results show that delayed layer-end eviction substantially expands feasible context lengths without sacrificing cache utility.
papers.comment: Accepted by The Journal of Systems Architecture

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值突出，但方法新颖性与证据深度中等。
pros: 提出按层延迟驱逐，抓住预填充峰值内存这一关键瓶颈

papers.title_zh: TideKV：通过分层分块预填充延迟 KV 驱逐，实现内存高效的长上下文 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文大语言模型 (LLM) 推理对于现代智能应用程序非常重要，但在提示预填充期间仍然受到峰值内存的限制。现有的 KV 缓存压缩减少了解码内存，但通常需要完全提示预填充来保留全局上下文，从而保留较高的构造峰值。在线块级逐出会更早地降低内存，但会在每层观察到完整提示之前进行选择，这可能会降低缓存构建和解码的性能。我们提出了 TideKV，一种使用主要层延迟驱逐的 GPU 缓存构建架构。 TideKV 处理每个 Transformer 层内的所有提示块，仅保留活动层的完整提示 KV，并在层末尾驱逐。该调度保留了完全提示感知的选择，同时减少了激活和临时内存。跨多个计算平台的实验表明，TideKV 保留了所评估的压缩方法的推理质量和最终缓存大小。在 A100 上为 64K 时，它将构建时间瞬态占用空间减少了 83.89%。在 RTX 4090 上，它在 64K 时仅将第一个令牌的时间增加了 1.06%，并启用了 128K 预填充。 TideKV 还在 Jetson 上完成了 128K，而匹配的预填充后压缩在两个资源受限的平台上都会耗尽内存。这些结果表明，延迟层端驱逐大大扩展了可行的上下文长度，而不会牺牲缓存效用。

papers.title: FlashMap: Flow Map Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose a block of tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel pass. Autoregressive drafters generate this block one token at a time, whereas block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate it in one pass, making drafting faster. However, these diffusion drafters predict each token independently, ignoring dependencies between tokens in the block. We introduce FlashMap, a continuous flow drafter that conditions a flow map language model on the target model's hidden states and generates the whole block in one forward pass while capturing inter-token dependencies. On Qwen3-8B, FlashMap is faster than a matched DFlash baseline on every benchmark, with 7% higher average speedup and up to 6.1x lossless acceleration.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但证据范围仍偏窄
pros: 将连续流模型用于块级草稿生成并显式建模块内依赖，较扩散独立预测更有方法贡献

papers.title_zh: FlashMap：流程图推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过使用轻量级起草者提出目标模型在一次并行传递中验证的标记块来加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理。自回归起草者一次生成一个令牌，而块扩散起草者（例如 DFlash）一次性生成它，从而使起草速度更快。然而，这些扩散起草者独立地预测每个令牌，忽略了块中令牌之间的依赖关系。我们引入了 FlashMap，这是一种连续流绘图器，它可以根据目标模型的隐藏状态调节流图语言模型，并在一次前向传递中生成整个块，同时捕获令牌间依赖关系。在 Qwen3-8B 上，FlashMap 在每个基准测试中都比匹配的 DFlash 基准更快，平均加速比高出 7%，无损加速高达 6.1 倍。

papers.title: Koi: Evidence-Guided, Self-Calibrating Planning for Multi-Cloud, Heterogeneous LLM Inference Fleets
papers.summary: Deploying a large language model (LLM) requires choosing the right accelerator, parallelization strategy, engine configuration, and replica count amongst ~140 other variables across clouds, regions, and markets. These decisions are intertwined, and the best cluster-wide plan continually changes as jobs contend for shared capacity on shifting workloads. We present Koi, a self-calibrating cluster planner for heterogeneous, multi-cloud fleets. Koi uses a Recursive Language Model (RLM) hierarchy to propose hypotheses and reason over deployment while deterministic components predict serving behavior, score candidates, and control placement. It represents inference behavior as a fixed causal graph linking decisions (e.g., accelerator, parallelism), runtime mediators (e.g., KV-cache pressure, communication overhead), and outcomes (e.g., latency, throughput). Each deployment strengthens or weakens scoped causal relationships, building a comprehensive playbook for inference that the planner employs to guide future decisions. Job-wise configurations are composed into cluster-wide plans and evaluated against serving objectives, resource constraints, SLO risks, and cost. Across benchmarks, Koi achieves 1.18x greater goodput than the strongest baseline while reducing $/token by 20% in a real heterogeneous cluster. Ablations isolate the contribution of Koi's architecture: a pure language model attains a composite score of 35.3, the same model equipped with Koi's deterministic tools reaches 51.6, and the full Koi planner reaches 70.8.

papers.title_zh: Koi：针对多云、异构 LLM 推理队列的证据引导、自我校准规划
papers.summary_zh: 部署大型语言模型 (LLM) 需要在跨云、区域和市场的约 140 个其他变量中选择正确的加速器、并行化策略、引擎配置和副本数量。这些决策相互交织，并且随着作业在不断变化的工作负载上争夺共享容量，最佳的集群范围计划会不断变化。我们推出 Koi，这是一种适用于异构、多云集群的自校准集群规划器。 Koi 使用递归语言模型 (RLM) 层次结构提出假设并推理部署，而确定性组件则预测服务行为、对候选者评分和控制布局。它将推理行为表示为链接决策（例如加速器、并行性）、运行时中介（例如 KV 缓存压力、通信开销）和结果（例如延迟、吞吐量）的固定因果图。每次部署都会加强或削弱范围内的因果关系，从而构建一个全面的推理手册，供规划者用来指导未来的决策。作业方面的配置被组成集群范围的计划，并根据服务目标、资源限制、SLO 风险和成本进行评估。在各个基准测试中，Koi 的吞吐量比最强基准高出 1.18 倍，同时在真正的异构集群中将每个代币的美元成本降低了 20%。 Ablations 隔离了 Koi 架构的贡献：纯语言模型的综合得分为 35.3，配备 Koi 确定性工具的同一模型达到 51.6，完整的 Koi 规划器达到 70.8。

papers.title: SigmaTrace: Library-Agnostic Observability for CPU/GPU-Initiated RDMA Communication
papers.summary: RDMA networking enables low-latency, high-bandwidth communication on large systems. Despite its adoption, however, observability is lacking. Existing tools target specific communication libraries or only report aggregated data, missing per-operation behavior. The gap is widest for GPU-initiated networking, whose in-kernel RDMA operations are invisible to the host. We present SigmaTrace, a library-agnostic RDMA profiling framework providing fine-grained, per-operation visibility for CPU and GPU-initiated networking. It traces operations at the libibverbs/mlx5dv layers, the common denominator beneath communication libraries on InfiniBand and RoCE, and employs a low-overhead memory interposition technique that, to our knowledge, gives the first observability into GPU-initiated RDMA without source patching or binary instrumentation. Host-side tracing adds 1.3% overhead on NCCL AllReduce at 128 GPUs and under 2% on RCCL at 1024 GPUs. On a persistent-kernel BFS and Mixture-of-Experts inference, SigmaTrace exposes an in-kernel barrier spread and 2.13x inter-node traffic skew invisible to existing profilers.
papers.comment: Accepted at SC26. Author's accepted manuscript. 13 pages, 10 figures, 1 table. Code: https://github.com/ParCoreLab/SigmaTrace

papers.title_zh: SigmaTrace：CPU/GPU 发起的 RDMA 通信与库无关的可观测性
papers.summary_zh: RDMA 网络可在大型系统上实现低延迟、高带宽通信。然而，尽管它被采用，但缺乏可观察性。现有工具针对特定的通信库或仅报告聚合数据，缺少每个操作的行为。对于 GPU 发起的网络来说，差距最大，其内核中的 RDMA 操作对主机来说是不可见的。我们推出了 SigmaTrace，这是一个与库无关的 RDMA 分析框架，为 CPU 和 GPU 启动的网络提供细粒度的、每个操作的可见性。它跟踪 libibverbs/mlx5dv 层的操作，这是 InfiniBand 和 RoCE 上通信库的共同点，并采用低开销内存插入技术，据我们所知，该技术首次可观察到 GPU 启动的 RDMA，无需源修补或二进制检测。主机端跟踪在 128 个 GPU 的 NCCL AllReduce 上增加了 1.3% 的开销，在 1024 个 GPU 的 RCCL 上增加了不到 2% 的开销。在持久内核 BFS 和专家混合推理中，SigmaTrace 暴露了现有分析器不可见的内核内屏障扩散和 2.13 倍节点间流量偏差。

papers.title: KVCompass: A Discovery Plane for Internet-Scale Prefix Cache Sharing in LLM Serving
papers.summary: KV cache reuse is one of the most effective ways to reduce LLM inference cost, but today its benefits are largely confined to a single cluster. When a provider serves the same model across geographically distributed regions, each region may repeatedly prefill the same popular prefixes, wasting GPU time and increasing time-to-first-token (TTFT). Exploiting reuse across regions involves discovering which worker currently holds a reusable KV cache for each request's prefix. We show that this KV cache discovery problem is structurally harder than conventional object lookup. Unlike hash-placement mechanisms such as DHTs, where an object's location is a deterministic function of its key, KV caches are created on the workers that serve requests, and their holder sets change with subsequent requests and KV cache evictions. KV cache discovery therefore calls for decoupling KV cache identity from placement. We present KVCompass, a discovery plane for Internet-scale KV cache sharing. The discovery index supports variable-length prefix lookup with constant-time local table reads at the edge, allowing each request to be forwarded to the worker that best balances KV cache reuse against load and network distance. Evaluation includes a 64-worker geo-distributed simulation and a 14-worker three-continent real-machine testbed. Evaluation shows that KVCompass achieves $1.3-14\times$ lower P99 TTFT than the baselines, up to $3.7\times$ lower P99 end-to-end latency, up to $4.7\times$ the throughput, and a peak load factor within 2% of the Oracle floor.
papers.comment: 26 pages. Accepted for publication in Proceedings of the ACM on Measurement and Analysis of Computing Systems (POMACS)

cons: 摘要未交代关键实现开销与一致性代价，且评测规模与工作负载多样性仍不足以完全支撑互联网级结论

papers.title_zh: KVCompass：LLM 服务中互联网规模前缀缓存共享的发现平面
papers.summary_zh: KV 缓存重用是降低 LLM 推理成本的最有效方法之一，但目前其优势主要局限于单个集群。当提供商跨地理分布的区域提供相同的模型时，每个区域可能会重复预填充相同的流行前缀，从而浪费 GPU 时间并增加首次令牌时间 (TTFT)。跨区域利用重用涉及发现哪个工作线程当前为每个请求的前缀保存可重用的 KV 缓存。我们证明这个 KV 缓存发现问题在结构上比传统的对象查找更难。与 DHT 等哈希放置机制不同，在 DHT 中，对象的位置是其键的确定性函数，KV 缓存是在服务请求的工作线程上创建的，并且它们的持有者集会随着后续请求和 KV 缓存驱逐而变化。因此，KV 缓存发现需要将 KV 缓存身份与放置解耦。我们推出了 KVCompass，一个用于互联网规模 KV 缓存共享的发现平面。发现索引支持可变长度前缀查找，并在边缘进行恒定时间本地表读取，允许将每个请求转发到能够最好地平衡 KV 缓存重用与负载和网络距离的工作线程。评估包括 64 名工作人员的地理分布式模拟和 14 名工作人员的三大洲真机测试台。评估显示，KVCompass 的 P99 TTFT 比基准降低了 1.3-14 美元，P99 端到端延迟降低了 3.7 美元，吞吐量提高了 4.7 美元，峰值负载系数在 Oracle 底线的 2% 以内。

papers.title: Acceptance Is Not Speed: Length Inflation in Training-Free Lossy Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model's output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule's most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts $1.34\times$ as many tokens per round but produces $1.54\times$ longer completions. For rules with higher acceptance lengths, tokens accepted only under relaxed verification tend to have low target-model probability, contributing to length inflation. For rules that reduce verifier rounds, accuracy typically drops substantially. Further analysis traces some failures to continued reasoning that exhausts the budget needed to deliver a final answer. Overall, accepted tokens per round alone is an unreliable measure of decoding speed under relaxed verification. Completion length and verifier rounds must also be reported to assess actual efficiency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，实证扎实但方法创新有限。
pros: 指出宽松验证下“长度膨胀”这一被忽视偏差，纠正单一速度指标误导
跨12组目标-草稿模型对比多维指标（长度/轮次/时延/精度），结论具实践价值
cons: 主要是系统性诊断与评测，缺少缓解长度膨胀的新算法或理论保证
结论目前聚焦training-free规则，向训练式或更广任务泛化仍需补证

papers.title_zh: 接受不是速度：免训练有损推测解码中的长度膨胀
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通常通过每轮验证接受的草稿令牌来表征加速。无损验证保留了目标模型的输出分布，从而保留了预期的完成长度，使该指标成为有意义的效率代理。宽松（有损）验证接受无损验证会拒绝的令牌，这可能会改变该分布。我们发现了一种长度膨胀现象：宽松的验证主要通过扩展推理轨迹来延长完成时间，很大程度上抵消了每轮接受代币的明显收益。我们评估了十二个目标起草者对现有的免培训宽松验证规则，并与相同提示的无损验证进行比较，测量完成长度、验证轮次、挂钟时间和任务准确性。在每个规则最宽松的评估设置下，宽松的验证平均每轮接受 $1.34\times$ 数量的代币，但会产生 $1.54\times$ 更长的完成时间。对于接受长度较高的规则，仅在宽松验证下接受的令牌往往具有较低的目标模型概率，从而导致长度膨胀。对于减少验证者轮次的规则，准确性通常会大幅下降。进一步的分析可以追溯到一些持续推理的失败，这些失败耗尽了提供最终答案所需的预算。总体而言，仅每轮接受的令牌是宽松验证下解码速度的不可靠衡量标准。还必须报告完成长度和验证轮次以评估实际效率。

papers.title: FuTransformer: FP8 prefill and INT4 decode for Llama-style inference on Hopper
papers.summary: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. For gate/up projection with SwiGLU at the 8B shape, our BF16 path is 1.13x faster than CODA. Our FP8 path is 2.02-2.18x faster than the evaluated BF16 CODA path. Across 8B and 70B shapes at batches 1-32, INT4 decode is 1.3-2.4x faster than the faster of PyTorch's BF16 and INT4 blocks at each point: 2.1-3.3x faster than compiled, CUDA-graphed BF16 and 1.3-6.3x faster than the same block using PyTorch's INT4 projection kernel, which targets a single query row and loses to BF16 at batch 32. It is also 31-51% faster than our FP8 path. Complete Llama-3.1-8B decode takes 2.8 ms per step at batch one, versus 8.1 ms for the compiled transformers implementation. Decoding every WikiText-2 token through the INT4 weight path raises perplexity from 6.24 to 7.23 with round-to-nearest weights or 6.99 with GPTQ in the same format; the rotated INT4 cache adds 0.20. The kernels match a quantized reference computation within 0.001 perplexity.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程优化扎实，性能突出，但精度与泛化证据不足。
pros: 针对prefill与decode瓶颈分治设计，FP8+INT4协同路径契合Hopper硬件特性
端到端与算子级加速幅度显著，且给出多基线对比与可复现的困惑度一致性检查
cons: 量化后困惑度退化明显（尤其全INT4权重路径），质量-效率权衡仍偏激进
评测范围主要集中在Llama形状与H100，跨模型、跨硬件与长上下文泛化证据不足

papers.title_zh: FuTransformer：FP8 预填充和 INT4 解码，用于 Hopper 上的 Llama 式推理
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 预填充重用跨 token 的权重，并以矩阵乘法和激活数据移动为主；单令牌解码的重用性有限，并且主要由权重和 KV 缓存读取主导。我们推出了 FUTRANSFORMER，它是适用于 NVIDIA Hopper GPU 的 Llama 风格 Transformer 块的 CUDA 实现。它将 CODA 的 GEMM-plus-epilogue 方法应用于推理，添加直接 KV 缓存放置，将固定 RMSNorm 增益折叠为权重，直接使用延迟缩放写入 FP8 输出，并支持无填充的预填充。解码使用 INT4 投影权重和 INT4 KV 缓存副本。权重和键遵循 Tensor Core 片段布局，直接反量化为 MMA 操作数，无需完整的中间块。块对角 Hadamard 变换减少了离群通道的缓存量化误差。在一台 H100 上，预填充速度比编译的 PyTorch FP8 快 1.48 倍，达到 1.29 PFLOP/s。对于 8B 形状的 SwiGLU 的门/上投影，我们的 BF16 路径比 CODA 快 1.13 倍。我们的 FP8 路径比评估的 BF16 CODA 路径快 2.02-2.18 倍。在批次 1-32 的 8B 和 70B 形状中，INT4 解码速度比 PyTorch 的 BF16 和 INT4 块在每个点的速度快 1.3-2.4 倍：比编译、CUDA 图形的 BF16 快 2.1-3.3 倍，比使用 PyTorch INT4 投影内核的同一块快 1.3-6.3 倍，该内核针对单个查询行和在第 32 批时输给了 BF16。它也比我们的 FP8 路径快 31-51%。完整的 Llama-3.1-8B 解码在第一批中每步需要 2.8 毫秒，而编译后的 Transformer 实现则需要 8.1 毫秒。通过 INT4 权重路径解码每个 WikiText-2 标记，使用舍入到最接近的权重时，困惑度从 6.24 提高到 7.23，使用相同格式的 GPTQ 时，困惑度从 6.99 提高；旋转后的 INT4 缓存增加了 0.20。内核与 0.001 困惑度内的量化参考计算相匹配。

papers.title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
papers.summary: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法有新意但证据尚不充分。
pros: 准确定位 agentic 场景下历史上下文导致的接受长度下降与系统开销双重瓶颈
提出 history-free 设计与两阶段训练，兼顾推理效率与可部署性，潜在影响较大
cons: 摘要缺少关键实验细节与统计稳健性说明，2-6 接受长度和 70% 提升的可比性边界不清
对额外训练成本、稳定性和不同模型规模泛化能力的证据不足

papers.title_zh: DLite：代理 AI 的无历史推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码已成为一种主流技术，通过使用轻量级草稿模型来生成随后由目标模型验证的候选标记，从而加速大型语言模型 (LLM) 推理。然而，代理工作负载引入了长期且不断发展的上下文和频繁的多轮交互。在这样的工作负载下，我们观察到现有的草稿模型的接受长度下降了高达 80%，同时维护其历史 KV 缓存会带来大量的系统开销。在本文中，我们将不断增长的历史背景确定为这两个问题的共同根源，并介绍了 DLite，这是一种用于代理 AI 的无历史推测解码框架。 DLite 直接重用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态并执行局部推测预测，而无需显式维护历史上下文，将日益复杂的建模问题转化为局部简单的预测问题。轻量级顺序头进一步以低开销恢复块内因果依赖性。为了有效地训练这种异构的无历史架构，我们引入了定制的两阶段训练策略。对通用、长上下文和代理工作负载的实验表明，DLite 实现了 2-6 的接受长度，并且优于最先进的推测解码方法 DSpark，高达 70%。

papers.title: Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains
papers.summary: The design space of modern AI/HPC systems has expanded rapidly across compute architectures, including GPUs, dataflow processors, and RISC-V accelerators; memory tech- nologies, including HBM, GDDR, and SRAM; and interconnects such as NVLink, UALink, Infinity Fabric, InfiniBand, Slingshot, and Ultra Ethernet. No single architecture is optimal across LLM training, LLM serving, and AI-coupled HPC workloads, while the resulting combinatorial design space is too large for manual exploration. We present ArchAgent, a hierarchical multi- agent framework in which an LLM-based planner decomposes system design into chip, scale-up, and scale-out subproblems, each handled by specialist agents. A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM. On a mixed AI+HPC workload under a 1 MW power budget, ArchAgent discovers heterogeneous designs that achieve a 1.93x weighted geometric mean speedup over a homogeneous GPU baseline, while requiring only 18 evaluations compared with 100 evaluations for hill climbing, which achieves 1.65x speedup.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 问题重要且结果亮眼，但证据链仍偏薄。
pros: 聚焦跨芯片/scale-up/scale-out联合设计，选题具有现实价值
采用分层多智能体+解析评估闭环，兼顾自动化探索与可解释性
cons: 摘要仅给出单一场景与基线对比，泛化性和稳健性证据不足
18次评估优于hill climbing的结论可能受对手方法与调参公平性影响

papers.title_zh: 用于跨芯片、纵向扩展和横向扩展域的异构系统设计的代理 AI
papers.summary_zh: 现代 AI/HPC 系统的设计空间在计算架构中迅速扩展，包括 GPU、数据流处理器和 RISC-V 加速器；存储器技术，包括 HBM、GDDR 和 SRAM；以及 NVLink、UALink、Infinity Fabric、InfiniBand、Slingshot 和 Ultra 以太网等互连。没有哪个单一架构能够在 LLM 训练、LLM 服务和 AI 耦合 HPC 工作负载方面达到最佳效果，而由此产生的组合设计空间对于手动探索来说太大了。我们提出了 ArchAgent，一个分层多代理框架，其中基于 LLM 的规划器将系统设计分解为芯片、扩展和扩展子问题，每个子问题都由专业代理处理。确定性分析评估器闭合循环，确保所有绩效评估均来自分析模型，而不是由法学硕士生成。在 1 MW 功率预算下的混合 AI+HPC 工作负载上，ArchAgent 发现异构设计在同质 GPU 基线上实现了 1.93 倍加权几何平均加速，同时只需要 18 次评估，而爬山则需要 100 次评估，实现了 1.65 倍加速。

papers.title: Trajectory-Triggered Sparse Collaborative Decoding
papers.summary: Dense assistance methods such as speculative decoding repeatedly verify draft tokens with a target model, keeping target computation coupled to generation. We study sparse collaborative decoding, where a draft model generates most tokens and a target model is invoked only for short corrective segments. The key problem is deciding when to call the target. We show that local uncertainty is a weak trigger: entropy, negative log-likelihood, logit margin, top-$k$ mass, and velocity features give near-chance failure prediction, with AUC 0.50-0.53. In contrast, aggregate trajectory-shape features over the draft confidence path reach AUC 0.86 using a lightweight logistic predictor trained only from draft correctness labels. This induces a trigger-timing tradeoff: early calls have more leverage but weaker evidence, while later calls have stronger evidence but less ability to redirect the trajectory. Used online, learned sparse collaborative decoding improves over the best open-loop schedule by +5.3 to +20.0 accuracy points across five GSM8K draft-target pairs. On MATH-500, it gains 7.0-13.5 points when early prediction and target competence align, but loses when either is weak. On StrategyQA, it improves over open-loop by 5.0-8.3 points, showing transfer beyond arithmetics.
papers.comment: 17 pages. Accepted at the EMNLP 2026 uncertainty workshop

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，但泛化与稳健性证据仍不足。
pros: 提出稀疏协作解码触发机制，区别于常规逐步验证范式
用轨迹形状特征显著优于局部不确定性触发，并报告跨任务增益
cons: 主要在少数推理基准与模型配对验证，负例显示方法对早期预测质量和目标模型能力较敏感，稳定性与通用性风险较高

papers.title_zh: 轨迹触发的稀疏协作解码
papers.summary_zh: 诸如推测解码之类的密集辅助方法用目标模型重复验证草稿令牌，使目标计算与生成保持耦合。我们研究稀疏协作解码，其中草稿模型生成大部分标记，而目标模型仅针对较短的纠正片段被调用。关键问题是决定何时呼叫目标。我们表明，局部不确定性是一个弱触发因素：熵、负对数似然、logit 裕度、top-$k$ 质量和速度特征给出了近似概率故障预测，AUC 为 0.50-0.53。相比之下，使用仅根据草稿正确性标签训练的轻量级逻辑预测器，草稿置信路径上的聚合轨迹形状特征达到 AUC 0.86。这导致了触发时机的权衡：早期的调用具有更大的杠杆作用，但证据较弱，而较晚的调用具有更强的证据，但重定向轨迹的能力较差。在线使用时，学习的稀疏协作解码在五个 GSM8K 草案目标对上比最佳开环调度提高了 +5.3 到 +20.0 的准确度点。在 MATH-500 上，当早期预测和目标能力一致时，它会获得 7.0-13.5 分，但当其中任何一个较弱时，它都会下降。在 StrategyQA 上，它比开环提高了 5.0-8.3 个点，显示出超越算术的迁移。

papers.title: HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs
papers.summary: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) has recently emerged as a promising technology that provides terabyte-scale accelerator-local capacity at bandwidths approaching HBM, with a potential cost-per-bit advantage over HBM. However, its NAND foundation brings long latency, out-of-place updates, and finite write endurance directly into the accelerator memory hierarchy, making its effects on performance and lifetime difficult to predict. To study this emerging design space, we present HBFSim, an LLM-aware event-driven simulator for heterogeneous HBM+HBF memory systems that preserves application-level memory semantics while modeling flash-internal behavior. HBFSim models HBM, HBF with host-managed flash translation, and conventional capacity tiers in one simulation driven by a calibrated serving frontend. Using HBFSim, we study decoding of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-235B-A22B under three workloads that differ in their input and output lengths. HBF serves data that does not fit in HBM 11.0--19.0$\times$ faster than host DRAM; HBM is better used to hold the running sequences' KV cache than as a cache for HBF; and at a published peak load of Llama-3.1-70B, HBF lasts 2.0 to 6.9 years, in proportion to the stacks that share the KV writes. The artifact is available at https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim and will track public HBF device data as it becomes available.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题重要且工程价值高，但证据链仍偏有限。
pros: 聚焦HBM+HBF新型层次内存，问题前沿且与大模型部署强相关
提供LLM感知事件驱动模拟器并开源，给出性能与寿命的定量结论
cons: 结论主要基于模拟与校准前端，缺少真实HBF硬件实测与广泛交叉验证
工作负载与模型覆盖面仍有限，通用性和外推性存在不确定性

papers.title_zh: HBFSim：用于探索 LLM 内存层次结构中的 HBF 的模拟器
papers.summary_zh: 高带宽闪存 (HBF) 最近成为一种很有前景的技术，它可以在接近 HBM 的带宽下提供 TB 级加速器本地容量，并且与 HBM 相比具有潜在的每比特成本优势。然而，其 NAND 基础将长延迟、异地更新和有限的写入耐久性直接带入加速器内存层次结构，使其对性能和寿命的影响难以预测。为了研究这个新兴的设计空间，我们推出了 HBFSim，这是一种用于异构 HBM+HBF 内存系统的 LLM 感知事件驱动模拟器，它在对闪存内部行为进行建模的同时保留了应用程序级内存语义。 HBFSim 在由校准服务前端驱动的一次模拟中对 HBM、具有主机管理闪存转换的 HBF 和传统容量层进行建模。使用 HBFSim，我们研究了在输入和输出长度不同的三种工作负载下 Llama-3.1-70B 和 Qwen3-235B-A22B 的解码。 HBF 提供不适合 HBM 11.0--19.0$\times$ 的数据，速度比主机 DRAM 快； HBM 更适合用于保存运行序列的 KV 缓存，而不是作为 HBF 的缓存；在已发布的 Llama-3.1-70B 峰值负载下，HBF 可以持续 2.0 到 6.9 年，与共享 KV 写入的堆栈成比例。该工件可在 https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim 上获取，并将在可用时跟踪公共 HBF 设备数据。

papers.title: Prism Attention: Proposal-Refined Index Sharing Mechanism for Efficient LLMs Inference
papers.summary: Long-context decoding in large language models (LLMs) is increasingly bottlenecked by the memory and computation required to attend over an ever-growing Key-Value (KV) cache at each autoregressive step. Although token-level sparse attention reduces this burden by restricting computation to a small subset of relevant past tokens, its practical gains are often offset by repeatedly recomputing layer-wise sparse indices as the context grows. A common remedy is to share sparse indices across layers by computing them only at designated anchor layers, but such static reuse ignores the layer-wise evolution of attention patterns, causing the reused indices to progressively deviate from the layer-specific optima and incur substantial attention loss. By revisiting cross-layer sparsity from the perspective of attention dynamics, we find that inter-layer salient token shift is highly localized: although the exact top-$κ$ indices differ across layers, the core high-attention tokens remain stable, with changes concentrated near the expanded boundary of previously selected regions. Motivated by this, we propose Prism Attention, a proposal-refined sparse attention framework. It replaces rigid cross-layer index reuse with a coarse-to-fine strategy, preserving layer-wise adaptability while retaining the efficiency benefits of cross-layer sharing. Extensive experiments show that Prism Attention achieves state-of-the-art performance among mainstream sparse attention methods on both reasoning and long-context benchmarks, while attaining a $3.4\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup over FlashAttention at 128K context length.
papers.comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026

quality.label: 较高

papers.title_zh: Prism Attention：提案细化索引共享机制，实现LLM高效推理
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型 (LLM) 中的长上下文解码越来越受到每个自回归步骤中不断增长的键值 (KV) 缓存所需的内存和计算的瓶颈。尽管令牌级稀疏注意力通过将计算限制为相关过去令牌的小子集来减轻这种负担，但随着上下文的增长，其实际收益通常会因重复重新计算分层稀疏索引而被抵消。一种常见的补救措施是通过仅在指定的锚层计算稀疏索引来跨层共享稀疏索引，但这种静态重用忽略了注意力模式的逐层演化，导致重用的索引逐渐偏离特定于层的最优值并导致大量的注意力损失。通过从注意力动态的角度重新审视跨层稀疏性，我们发现层间显着令牌转移是高度局部化的：尽管确切的 top-$κ$ 指数在各层之间有所不同，但核心高注意力令牌保持稳定，变化集中在先前选择区域的扩展边界附近。受此启发，我们提出了 Prism Attention，这是一种经过提案改进的稀疏注意力框架。它用从粗到细的策略取代了严格的跨层索引重用，保留了分层适应性，同时保留了跨层共享的效率优势。大量实验表明，Prism Attention 在推理和长上下文基准测试中均实现了主流稀疏注意力方法中最先进的性能，同时在 128K 上下文长度下比 FlashAttention 实现了 $3.4\times$ 的端到端解码加速。

papers.title: BS-Spec: BFP-Based Bit-Sharing for Self-Speculative LLM Decoding with LUT-Driven Mixed-Precision Acceleration
papers.summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across diverse inference services, serving workloads span a wide range of batch sizes, context lengths, and performance requirements. Speculative decoding improves inference throughput, but conventional approaches require a separate draft model and KV cache, while existing self-speculative methods suffer from workload-insensitive draft configurations and inefficient mixed-precision execution. In this paper, we present BS-Spec, a block floating point (BFP)-based bit-sharing framework that jointly optimizes draft construction, workload-aware precision selection, and hardware execution. BS-Spec derives multiple draft representations directly from a single BFP target model by partially loading the most significant bits of weights and the KV cache while preserving shared exponents, eliminating separate draft-model storage. Offline calibration selects the weight and KV-cache precision pair that maximizes estimated speedup for each serving regime, and a precision lookup table applies the selected configuration at runtime. To support this adaptive execution, we design a mixed-precision BFP accelerator with a lookup table (LUT)-based variable-precision datapath for both draft and target computation. Experimental results show that BS-Spec achieves up to $1.9\times$ speedup over conventional autoregressive decoding and improves speedup over the evaluated bit-sharing self-speculative decoding baselines by $67.2\%$ on average, demonstrating the benefits of jointly co-designing bit sharing, precision adaptation, and specialized hardware for diverse LLM serving workloads.

papers.title_zh: BS-Spec：基于 BFP 的位共享，用于具有 LUT 驱动的混合精度加速的自推测 LLM 解码
papers.summary_zh: 随着大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地部署在不同的推理服务中，服务工作负载涵盖了各种批量大小、上下文长度和性能要求。推测性解码提高了推理吞吐量，但传统方法需要单独的草稿模型和 KV 缓存，而现有的自推测方法受到工作负载不敏感的草稿配置和低效的混合精度执行的影响。在本文中，我们提出了 BS-Spec，这是一种基于块浮点 (BFP) 的位共享框架，可联合优化草稿构造、工作负载感知精度选择和硬件执行。 BS-Spec 通过部分加载权重的最高有效位和 KV 缓存，同时保留共享指数，从而消除单独的草稿模型存储，直接从单个 BFP 目标模型导出多个草稿表示。离线校准选择权重和 KV 缓存精度对，以最大化每个服务方案的估计加速，并且精度查找表在运行时应用所选配置。为了支持这种自适应执行，我们设计了一个混合精度 BFP 加速器，具有基于查找表 (LUT) 的可变精度数据路径，用于草图和目标计算。实验结果表明，BS-Spec 比传统自回归解码实现了高达 $1.9\times$ 的加速，并且比评估的位共享自推测解码基线平均提高了 $67.2\%$ 的加速，展示了针对不同 LLM 服务工作负载联合共同设计位共享、精度自适应和专用硬件的好处。

papers.title: Shape-Aware Neural Time Fields for Rigid-Body Motion and Manipulation Planning
papers.summary: Rigid-body motion planning is fundamental to robotic transport and manipulation, where both object position and orientation determine whether a body can move through cluttered environments. This coupling makes planning chal- lenging because translation and rotation can be constrained very differently by surrounding geometry. We propose Shape- Aware Neural Time Fields, a physics-informed neural motion planning framework that learns a reusable travel-time, or cost- to-go, representation for rigid-body motion while explicitly accounting for these distinct geometric restrictions. The learned field captures local motion difficulty in translation and rotation and is paired with a sampling-based planner that balances progress toward the goal with the cost of reaching nearby poses. We evaluate the framework across 2D and 3D rigid- body planning tasks and non-prehensile manipulation through object pushing in diverse environments. Results show substantial improvements in planning success and inference efficiency over physics-informed neural planning baselines, while remaining competitive with classical sampling-based planners at significantly lower planning times. Ablation studies further validate the contributions of both the learned representation and the proposed planning strategy. Finally, closed-loop pushing experiments under execution deviations and external disturbances demonstrate that fast replanning enables reactive and adaptive task execution.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且实用，但证据链仍偏摘要化。
pros: 将形状感知与时间场结合，针对平移/旋转耦合约束建模较到位

papers.title_zh: 用于刚体运动和操纵规划的形状感知神经时间场
papers.summary_zh: 刚体运动规划是机器人运输和操纵的基础，其中物体的位置和方向决定了物体是否可以在杂乱的环境中移动。这种耦合使得规划具有挑战性，因为平移和旋转可能受到周围几何形状的非常不同的约束。我们提出了形状感知神经时间场，这是一种基于物理的神经运动规划框架，它学习可重复使用的行程时间或移动成本表示刚体运动，同时明确考虑这些不同的几何限制。学习场捕获平移和旋转中的局部运动难度，并与基于采样的规划器配对，平衡实现目标的进度与达到附近姿势的成本。我们评估了 2D 和 3D 刚体规划任务以及通过在不同环境中推动对象的非抓握操作的框架。结果表明，与基于物理的神经规划基线相比，规划成功率和推理效率有了显着提高，同时在规划时间显着缩短的情况下，仍与基于采样的经典规划器保持竞争力。消融研究进一步验证了学习到的表示和提出的规划策略的贡献。最后，执行偏差和外部干扰下的闭环推动实验表明，快速重新规划可以实现反应性和自适应任务执行。

papers.title: SAFETYEDIT: Sparse Internal Targets with Prompt-Wide Control for LLM Jailbreak Backdoors
papers.summary: Model-editing backdoors aim to induce harmful responses under a trigger while preserving ordinary behavior on untriggered input. Recent model-editing approaches target affirmative response prefixes through rank-one updates to a small subset of model weights. Yet when this prefix-level target is satisfied, the model may still revert to refusal or produce a coherent, apparently compliant response that does not address the request. To overcome this limitation, existing internal-representation approaches shift focus from output tokens to dense, high-dimensional compliance directions in latent space. Existing representation-level approaches rely on preservation constraints to maintain conditionality, motivating us to ask whether a smaller internal target can offer a different effectiveness-preservation trade-off. Motivated by the comparable control capability of single-coordinate interventions, we investigate a sparse refusal-related MLP coordinate as this target. We propose SAFETYEDIT, which optimizes a single refusal-related coordinate and uses KV-cache marking in early attention layers to propagate a prefix-trigger signal across subsequent instruction positions. On some checkpoints a downstream MLP reader converts this signal into control of the coordinate, while on others the propagated signal alone suffices; the method is defined by the sparse target rather than by a fixed writer-reader pair. Across four open-weight LLMs and three dataset groups, SAFETYEDIT achieves the highest triggered Guard ASR in 11 of 12 comparisons and the highest mean StrongREJECT score in all 12, relative to the baselines evaluated for each model. Crucially, comprehensive ablation and behavioral audits confirm generally minimal changes in untriggered behavior and general capabilities in the tested configurations.

papers.title_zh: SAFETYEDIT：稀疏内部目标与 LLM 越狱后门的快速范围控制
papers.summary_zh: 模型编辑后门旨在在触发条件下引发有害反应，同时保留未触发输入的正常行为。最近的模型编辑方法通过对一小部分模型权重进行一级更新来针对肯定响应前缀。然而，当满足此前缀级目标时，模型仍可能会恢复拒绝或生成不解决请求的连贯的、明显合规的响应。为了克服这一限制，现有的内部表示方法将焦点从输出标记转移到潜在空间中的密集、高维顺从方向。现有的代表性水平方法依赖于保留约束来维持条件性，这促使我们询问较小的内部目标是否可以提供不同的有效性-保留权衡。受单坐标干预的可比控制能力的启发，我们研究了稀疏拒绝相关的 MLP 坐标作为该目标。我们提出 SAFETYEDIT，它优化单个与拒绝相关的坐标，并在早期注意层中使用 KV 缓存标记来在后续指令位置传播前缀触发信号。在某些检查点上，下游 MLP 读取器将此信号转换为坐标控制，而在其他检查点上，仅传播信号就足够了；该方法是由稀疏目标而不是固定的写入器-读取器对定义的。在四个开放权重法学硕士和三个数据集组中，相对于每个模型评估的基线，SAFETYEDIT 在 12 次比较中的 11 次中实现了最高的触发 Guard ASR，并在所有 12 次比较中实现了最高的平均 StrongREJECT 分数。至关重要的是，全面的消融和行为审核确认了测试配置中未触发行为和一般功能的变化通常很小。

papers.title: MemLLM: End-to-end In-Storage Acceleration of On-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Precomputed KV Caches
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices enables personalized large language model (LLM) inference while preserving privacy. However, RAG's inherent length asymmetry makes the prefill phase the dominant bottleneck. While precomputing the KV caches offline alleviates the prefill cost on server systems, the multi-gigabyte caches over the narrow interconnect create a severe I/O wall for on-device systems. To mitigate this, we propose MemLLM, an end-to-end in-storage processing (ISP) architecture that executes the complete attention pipeline based on precomputed KV caches within the SSD. MemLLM utilizes per-channel accelerators to fully utilize the aggregated NAND channel bandwidth and accelerates all KV cache-related computations on the storage-side to minimize PCIe transfers. To efficiently handle the sparse updates required by RAG, MemLLM introduces a fused recomputation-query kernel paired with a hardware-based filter logic to halve the NAND read volume and eliminate write-back penalties. Furthermore, MemLLM's global SRAM-based stateful reduction engine enables a completely DRAM-less dataflow, thereby removing the internal memory bottlenecks and bounding the PCIe egress to an $O(1)$ footprint. A full-stack software stack allows asynchronous, zero-copy transfers from the ISP to the host and provides transparent execution within modern ML frameworks. Evaluated across eight real-world RAG datasets and six on-device LLM models, MemLLM achieves an average end-to-end speedup of 4.06$\times$ over the GPU baseline.
papers.comment: To be published in IEEE/ACM MICRO 2026

papers.title_zh: MemLLM：使用预计算 KV 缓存对设备上检索增强生成进行端到端存储加速
papers.summary_zh: 边缘设备上的检索增强生成 (RAG) 可实现个性化大语言模型 (LLM) 推理，同时保护隐私。然而，RAG 固有的长度不对称性使得预填充阶段成为主要瓶颈。虽然离线预计算 KV 缓存可以减轻服务器系统上的预填充成本，但窄互连上的数 GB 缓存为设备上的系统创建了严重的 I/O 墙。为了缓解这个问题，我们提出了 MemLLM，这是一种端到端存储内处理 (ISP) 架构，它基于 SSD 内预先计算的 KV 缓存执行完整的注意力管道。 MemLLM 利用每通道加速器来充分利用聚合的 NAND 通道带宽，并加速存储端所有与 KV 缓存相关的计算，以最大限度地减少 PCIe 传输。为了有效处理 RAG 所需的稀疏更新，MemLLM 引入了融合的重新计算查询内核，与基于硬件的过滤器逻辑配对，以将 NAND 读取量减半并消除回写惩罚。此外，MemLLM 的基于 SRAM 的全局状态缩减引擎可实现完全无 DRAM 的数据流，从而消除内部内存瓶颈并将 PCIe 出口限制在 $O(1)$ 占用空间内。全栈软件堆栈允许从 ISP 到主机的异步、零拷贝传输，并在现代机器学习框架内提供透明的执行。通过对 8 个真实世界的 RAG 数据集和 6 个设备上的 LLM 模型进行评估，MemLLM 实现了比 GPU 基线 4.06$\times$ 的平均端到端加速。

papers.title: On the SPOT: Enhancing Speculative Decoding for Diffusion Language Models via Commit-Order Prediction
papers.summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise parallel text generation, but in practice face an unresolved speed-quality trade-off. Exact decoding fills in only one masked position per model pass, while faster multi-token decoding schemes are lossy. Speculative decoding is the standard lossless acceleration for autoregressive models. However, it does not transfer directly to DLMs, which must choose both what to generate and where. We show that this order is the missing piece: the model's own predictions from the previous pass already give the right token at 92-100% of positions, but not which position comes next. Based on this observation, we introduce Speculating Positions Order Trajectory (SPOT), which learns to predict this order. A 0.62M-parameter model reads only the target's output distributions and proposes a tree of candidate continuations, and the target verifies all of them in a single pass by checking whether each equals its own next state. On the verification side, our analysis shows that prior block-diffusion verification approaches either assume $T=0$ or a sequential proposal interface. To support tree-based speculation at any temperature, we propose using coupled-noise match verification for diffusion blocks, following shared-Gumbel-noise coupling approaches. Our comprehensive experiments show that SPOT cuts target passes by up to 6.8x and reaches up to 3.2x the throughput of standard decoding, beating the calibrated and training-free drafting baselines in every task and budget at $T=0$ and $T=1$. In addition, we show that the learned drafter transfers across models, demonstrating successful transfer across six different DLMs. Project page: https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准，方法新颖且实证充分，具备较强发表竞争力。

papers.title_zh: 现场：通过提交顺序预测增强扩散语言模型的推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 扩散语言模型 (DLM) 有望实现并行文本生成，但实际上面临着未解决的速度与质量权衡问题。精确解码每次模型传递仅填充一个掩码位置，而更快的多令牌解码方案是有损的。推测解码是自回归模型的标准无损加速。但是，它不会直接传输到 DLM，DLM 必须选择生成内容和生成位置。我们证明这个顺序是缺失的部分：模型自己对前一遍的预测已经在 92-100% 的位置给出了正确的标记，但没有给出下一个位置。基于这一观察，我们引入了推测头寸订单轨迹（SPOT），它可以学习预测该订单。 0.62M 参数模型仅读取目标的输出分布并提出候选延续树，目标通过检查每个分布是否等于其自己的下一个状态来一次性验证所有这些分布。在验证方面，我们的分析表明，先前的块扩散验证方法要么假设 $T=0$ 要么假设顺序提案接口。为了支持任何温度下基于树的推测，我们建议遵循共享 Gumbel 噪声耦合方法，对扩散块使用耦合噪声匹配验证。我们的综合实验表明，SPOT 将目标传递次数减少了 6.8 倍，标准解码的吞吐量提高了 3.2 倍，在 $T=0$ 和 $T=1$ 的每项任务和预算中都击败了经过校准和免训练的绘图基线。此外，我们还展示了学习的绘图员跨模型迁移，展示了跨六个不同 DLM 的成功迁移。项目页面：https://eliezer318.github.io/SPOT-dLLM/

papers.title: PACE: Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs
papers.summary: Native multimodal large language models (native MLLMs) jointly encode visual and linguistic sequences within a unified autoregressive Transformer, emerging as a promising paradigm for multimodal understanding. Unlike conventional ViT-based MLLMs relying on external vision encoders, ViT-free native MLLMs tokenize pixel patches directly, potentially suffering severe visual token redundancy. A pilot study confirms this: unlike ViT-based models that degrade under compression, ViT-free MLLMs tolerate aggressive compression with near-lossless or even improved performance. Yet existing compression methods target ViT-based settings, leaving native MLLMs, which stand to gain the most, unexplored. To close this gap, we introduce an analysis pipeline centered on token discriminability and cross-dimensional heterogeneous redundancy, revealing that (i) redundancy is distributed independently and heterogeneously along height and width axes, and (ii) early-layer visual tokens are indiscriminable and uniformly redundant. Guided by these findings, we propose PACE (Pareto-Adaptive Compression for Efficient Native MLLMs), the first visual token compression framework tailored for native MLLMs with Multimodal-RoPE. Leveraging dimensional decoupling of positional encoding, PACE decomposes attention into two orthogonal spatial saliency estimates along height and width, gated by a positional attention signal, yielding direction-aware importance with negligible overhead. It further casts token budget allocation as Pareto optimization over performance preservation, inference efficiency, and spatial coverage, jointly identifying optimal compression depths and retention ratios. Experiments show PACE maintains near-lossless performance at only 25%-50% visual token retention, even improving several benchmarks, while delivering over 2x FLOPs reduction.

pros: 聚焦原生MLLM视觉冗余这一高价值且少被系统研究的问题
