papers.title_zh: MultiAlloc：KV 缓存量化的预算感知精确分配
papers.summary_zh: 键值（KV）缓存是大语言模型（LLM）推理过程中内存消耗的主要来源，特别是在长上下文和复杂的推理场景中。现有的KV缓存量化方法探索了不同的压缩粒度，包括逐层精度调整和token级信息保存。然而，在实际部署中，关键的挑战不仅仅是压缩，而是如何在固定的KV缓存内存预算下，在异构精度保存策略之间分配有限的量化资源。我们提出了 MultiAlloc，一种用于 KV 缓存量化的分析引导精度分配框架，它在逐层精度增强和逐令牌保存之间自适应地分配有限的量化资源。 MultiAlloc 采用轻量级离线分析来表征层敏感性和令牌重要性，从而在固定内存约束下实现自适应精度分配。在分析内存与准确性权衡的指导下，它会自动导出有效的精度分配策略，而无需在线分配搜索，并在推理过程中应用生成的策略。关于推理和长上下文基准的大量实验表明，MultiAlloc 在不同模型（包括 Mistral、Llama、DeepSeek-Qwen 和 QwQ）的匹配内存预算下，持续改进了逐层、逐令牌和最新的多粒度 KV 缓存量化方法。

papers.title: FrameScout: Scouting Query-Relevant Frames for Long Video Understanding
papers.summary: Long video understanding requires VideoLLMs to answer queries about videos spanning tens of minutes to hours, but such long videos produce far more visual tokens than current VideoLLMs can process. To address this issue, keyframe selectors are proposed to select the most query-relevant frames by computing the similarity between frame and query embeddings. Existing selectors either encode frames independently without temporal context or process chunks in isolation with ranking objectives that are difficult to optimize. To alleviate those limitations, we propose FrameScout with two core designs: (i) a streaming selector architecture that leverages a sliding-window KV cache and successor aggregation to produce temporally-contextualized frame embeddings; (ii) a frame-query contrastive objective that aligns frame and query embeddings in a shared space, directly training the selector to distinguish relevant frames from irrelevant ones. Extensive experiments on three long-video benchmarks and six base VideoLLMs demonstrate that FrameScout consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案完整，但证据仍需更严谨验证。

papers.title_zh: FrameScout：搜寻与查询相关的帧以实现长视频理解
papers.summary_zh: 长视频理解需要 VideoLLM 回答有关数十分钟到几小时的视频的查询，但如此长的视频产生的视觉标记比当前 VideoLLM 可以处理的多得多。为了解决这个问题，提出了关键帧选择器通过计算帧和查询嵌入之间的相似度来选择与查询最相关的帧。现有的选择器要么在没有时间上下文的情况下独立编码帧，要么单独处理难以优化的排名目标的块。为了缓解这些限制，我们提出了具有两个核心设计的 FrameScout：（i）流式选择器架构，利用滑动窗口 KV 缓存和后继聚合来生成时​​间上下文化的帧嵌入； (ii) 框架-查询对比目标，将框架和查询嵌入在共享空间中对齐，直接训练选择器以区分相关帧和不相关帧。对三个长视频基准测试和六个基础 VideoLLM 进行的大量实验表明，FrameScout 始终能够实现最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/Hubert-1102/FrameScout 获取。

papers.title: RadixFlow: Filling Execution Bubbles in Prefix-Cached Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.summary: Prefix reuse improves LLM inference by sharing the KV cache of common prompt prefixes. This helps only if the scheduler can execute a matched branch in the current worker round. Schedulers assume that a matched prefix is ready, which holds for full attention but fails for hybrid LLMs. There, a branch (the consumer) may need recurrent state that another branch (the producer) is still computing in the same round. The native scheduler stops its waiting-queue scan at this blocked consumer, and the resulting head-of-line blocking creates \emph{execution bubbles}: idle batch slots that independent work could fill. We introduce RadixFlow, which decouples prefix matching from state readiness. Its state-ready traversal turns a global scan barrier into a local wait: only the consumer is blocked until the next round, while feasible independent branches keep filling the batch under the native state check. On five hybrid models, RadixFlow lowers mean latency by 3\% to 24\% and worker rounds by 11\% to 44\% at almost unchanged reuse. On the larger Qwen3.5 models, ablations show that most of the gain comes from traversal, which adds little on a full-attention control. Heavier rounds limit how much of this saving reaches latency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，工程价值较高但理论深度一般
pros: 准确识别混合模型前缀复用中的执行气泡与队首阻塞瓶颈
方案改动聚焦调度遍历并在多模型上给出稳定延迟与轮次收益
cons: 从摘要看缺少更强理论分析与更广负载/系统设置下的泛化与边界验证

papers.title_zh: RadixFlow：在前缀缓存混合 LLM 服务中填充执行气泡
papers.summary_zh: 前缀重用通过共享常见提示前缀的 KV 缓存来改进 LLM 推理。仅当调度程序可以在当前工作轮中执行匹配的分支时，这才有帮助。调度程序假设匹配的前缀已准备就绪，这可以引起充分关注，但对于混合 LLM 来说则失败。在那里，一个分支（消费者）可能需要另一个分支（生产者）仍在同一轮中计算的循环状态。本机调度程序在这个被阻塞的消费者处停止其等待队列扫描，并且由此产生的队头阻塞会创建\emph{执行气泡}：独立工作可以填充的空闲批处理槽。我们引入 RadixFlow，它将前缀匹配与状态准备情况解耦。它的状态就绪遍历将全局扫描屏障转变为本地等待：只有消费者在下一轮之前被阻塞，而可行的独立分支在本机状态检查下继续填充批次。在五种混合模型上，RadixFlow 将平均延迟降低了 3% 到 24%，工作轮数降低了 11% 到 44%，而重用率几乎没有变化。在较大的 Qwen3.5 模型上，消融表明大部分增益来自遍历，这对全注意力控制几乎没有增加。较重的回合限制了这种节省达到延迟的程度。

papers.title: LatentRemedy: Efficient Remedy For Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in Multi-Agent Systems
papers.summary: Non-prefix KV cache reuse is a promising approach for improving inference efficiency in multi-agent systems as agents share the same context blocks. However, when agents have conflicting tasks, directly reusing non-prefix KV caches across agents can severely degrade model performance, causing up to a 90% drop. Existing remedies, including selective recomputation and offset-based calibration, recover a limited fraction of this loss. We argue that the problem lies not only in contaminated KV representations but also in the agent's difficulty interpreting reused context under its own instructions. To this end, we introduce LatentRemedy, which uses a few task-conditioned latent tokens to help the target agent leverage reused context without recomputing the shared block. Specifically, we use an MLP to map the last hidden state of the target prefix into a small number of latent tokens, which are placed after the reused KV block to interact with the shared context. To guide subsequent predictions toward the target task, we train the MLP through full-prefill distillation. Experiments show that LatentRemedy consistently outperforms existing reuse baselines on conflicting tasks while maintaining TTFT close to direct reuse as cache size grows. Code and data are available at https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法有新意但证据仍偏初步。
pros: 准确聚焦非前缀KV复用在多智能体冲突任务中的性能塌陷问题，应用价值明确

papers.title_zh: LatentRemedy：多代理系统中非前缀 KV 缓存重用的有效补救措施
papers.summary_zh: 由于代理共享相同的上下文块，无前缀 KV 缓存重用是提高多代理系统中推理效率的一种有前途的方法。然而，当智能体有冲突的任务时，跨智能体直接重用非前缀 KV 缓存可能会严重降低模型性能，导致高达 90% 的下降。现有的补救措施，包括选择性重新计算和基于偏移的校准，只能弥补这种损失的有限部分。我们认为，问题不仅在于受污染的 KV 表示，还在于智能体难以根据自己的指令解释重用的上下文。为此，我们引入了 LatentRemedy，它使用一些任务条件的潜在令牌来帮助目标代理利用重用的上下文，而无需重新计算共享块。具体来说，我们使用 MLP 将目标前缀的最后一个隐藏状态映射到少量潜在令牌中，这些潜在令牌被放置在重用的 KV 块之后以与共享上下文交互。为了指导后续对目标任务的预测，我们通过全预填充蒸馏来训练 MLP。实验表明，LatentRemedy 在冲突任务上始终优于现有的重用基线，同时随着缓存大小的增长，保持 TTFT 接近直接重用。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/chenzhwsysu57/kvreuse 获取。

papers.title: BELT : BEhavior-Aligned Low-Rank KV Cache Compression with Learned Top-k Rank Allocation
papers.summary: Long-context inference makes the key-value (KV) cache a major memory bottleneck for large language models. We propose BELT, a low-rank KV cache compression framework. Its key-side objective targets attention distributions rather than raw keys or pre-softmax logits, yielding a quadratic surrogate with a closed-form low-rank solution. A learned global rank allocator uses differentiable soft selection during training and hard selection at deployment to meet a user-specified component budget. Experiments demonstrate improved model quality under aggressive compression and increased decoding throughput at comparable accuracy. Evaluated across three LLMs and multiple benchmarks, BELT achieves up to 70% low-rank KV cache compression while outperforming the strongest baseline by up to 23.3 points on LongBench, and up to 17.8x overall KV cache reduction when combined with quantization. With Triton-based GPU kernels and a quantized cache, BELT delivers up to 2.7x speedup for the attention module and 3.3x end-to-end decoding throughput.

papers.title_zh: BELT：具有学习的 Top-k Rank 分配的行为对齐低阶 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文推理使键值 (KV) 缓存成为大型语言模型的主要内存瓶颈。我们提出了 BELT，一种低阶 KV 缓存压缩框架。它的关键侧目标针对的是注意力分布，而不是原始关键点或 pre-softmax logits，产生具有封闭形式低秩解决方案的二次代理。学习的全局排名分配器在训练期间使用可微的软选择，在部署时使用硬选择，以满足用户指定的组件预算。实验表明，在积极压缩的情况下模型质量得到了提高，并且解码吞吐量在相当的精度下得到了提高。经过三个 LLM 和多个基准测试的评估，BELT 实现了高达 70% 的低阶 KV 缓存压缩，同时在 LongBench 上比最强基准高出高达 23.3 分，与量化相结合时，整体 KV 缓存减少量高达 17.8 倍。凭借基于 Triton 的 GPU 内核和量化缓存，BELT 为注意力模块提供高达 2.7 倍的加速，并提供 3.3 倍的端到端解码吞吐量。

papers.title: HaloBlock: Faster and Better Decoding for Diffusion Large Language Models
papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have attracted increasing research attention due to their bidirectional attention and arbitrary order decoding. However, there are two issues in dLLMs inference: the decoding difficulty is dominated by the tokens on the right side of the block, and the block-wise decoding inherently suffers from boundary contextual discontinuity. To tackle these limitations, we propose HaloBlock, a difficulty-aware adaptive halo mechanism for dLLM inference. We first leverage bidirectional cumulative entropy to characterize block decoding difficulty. Then, based on the bidirectional decoding difficulty, we adaptively allocate bidirectional halo regions on both sides of each block to mitigate boundary contextual discontinuity. The difficulty-aware design of HaloBlock smooths cross-block context propagation and lowers decoding difficulty for hard tokens, yielding better generation quality and faster convergence. Evaluated on LLaDA-8B-Instruct, Dream-7B-Instruct and LLaDA-1.5 across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, HaloBlock demonstrates consistent accuracy improvements and higher inference efficiency. Source codes are publicly available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路实用且有潜力，但证据完整性待加强。

papers.title_zh: HaloBlock：更快更好地解码扩散大型语言模型
papers.summary_zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）由于其双向注意力和任意顺序解码而吸引了越来越多的研究关注。然而，dLLM 推理存在两个问题：解码难度主要由块右侧的标记决定，并且按块解码本质上会受到边界上下文不连续性的影响。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了 HaloBlock，一种用于 dLLM 推理的难度感知自适应光环机制。我们首先利用双向累积熵来表征块解码难度。然后，根据双向解码难度，我们自适应地在每个块的两侧分配双向光环区域，以减轻边界上下文不连续性。 HaloBlock 的难度感知设计可平滑跨区块上下文传播并降低硬代币的解码难度，从而产生更好的生成质量和更快的收敛速度。 HaloBlock 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct、Dream-7B-Instruct 和 LLaDA-1.5 的数学推理和代码生成基准上进行了评估，展示了一致的准确性改进和更高的推理效率。源代码可在 https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/HaloBlock 上公开获取。

papers.title: Batch-Paced: Fixed-Budget Batch Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
papers.summary: As generative language models become more capable and widely used, inference demand grows, making efficient serving increasingly important. Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising path to more efficient inference through parallel token generation. Prior dLLM decoding methods, however, focus on improving inference efficiency for individual sequences. We formulate fixed-budget dLLM batch decoding and introduce Batch-Paced, a training-free method that jointly optimizes the allocation of decoding compute across requests to improve overall batch quality. Across two dLLM backbones, five benchmarks and their representative mixtures, Batch-Paced improves batch performance under matched budgets; gains generally grow with batch size and largely persist across decoding configurations. Analysis of requests' decoding trajectories suggests that these gains arise largely by raising the committed-token confidence of lower-confidence requests. We further show that Batch-Paced's batch decode time remains competitive and that adding a decoding-depth allowance during Batch-Paced decoding can shorten it further at a modest performance cost.

papers.title_zh: 批量节奏：离散扩散语言模型中的固定预算批量解码
papers.summary_zh: 随着生成语言模型的能力变得越来越强大并得到广泛使用，推理需求不断增长，使得高效服务变得越来越重要。离散扩散语言模型 (dLLM) 为通过并行标记生成进行更有效的推理提供了一条有希望的途径。然而，先前的 dLLM 解码方法侧重于提高单个序列的推理效率。我们制定了固定预算 dLLM 批量解码，并引入了 Batch-Paced，这是一种免训练方法，可联合优化跨请求的解码计算分配，以提高整体批量质量。 Batch-Paced 在两个 dLLM 主干、五个基准及其代表性混合物中提高了匹配预算下的批量性能；增益通常随着批量大小而增长，并且在解码配置中很大程度上持续存在。对请求解码轨迹的分析表明，这些收益主要是通过提高较低置信度请求的承诺令牌置信度来实现的。我们进一步表明，Batch-Paced 的批量解码时间仍然具有竞争力，并且在 Batch-Paced 解码期间添加解码深度限额可以以适度的性能成本进一步缩短时间。

papers.title: FlashMask-3: Efficient and Expressive Mask-Aware Distributed Attention
papers.summary: Long-context training of large language and multimodal models couples structured attention masks (document, prefix-LM, share-question, sliding-window, block-sparse) with multi-node context parallelism, making the mask a dominant bottleneck. FlashMask's column-wise sparse mask compresses them from $O(n^2)$ to $O(n)$ via four query-axis boundary vectors, covering broad structured patterns. Implemented for Ampere GPUs, it neither exploits FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA warp-specialized pipeline on Hopper nor supports distribution. The column-wise sparse mask is indexed by key positions but stores query-axis interval boundaries. Under any multi-chunk context-parallel assignment, it reduces per-rank mask localization to a provably zero-communication \emph{clip--shift--max} on the boundary vectors, compatible with the single-GPU kernel. FlashMask-3 introduces a mask-aware Hopper kernel with three-role warp specialization atop FlashAttention-3's TMA/WGMMA pipeline, plus a mask-aware distributed extension: zero-communication mask localization, a sparsity-aware load balancer (HCC-IPO), and a mask-aware compute-communication overlap with mask-driven communication pruning, whose forward all-gather uses topology-aware hierarchical routing. On a single H100 across 12 masks at 4K--128K context, it improves achieved TFLOPs over FlashMask, FlexAttention, and MagiAttention by 45--141%, 34--71%, and 2--44%. At context-parallel degrees 4--32 with 8K sequence per device, it attains 31--75% compute-communication overlap efficiency and improves throughput over Megatron-Core CP ring, Megatron-Core CP all-gather, and MagiAttention by $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$, $1.71\times$--$2.92\times$, and $1.09\times$--$1.46\times$. In end-to-end training of a 118B-A14B MoE at 128K on 128 H100 GPUs, it raises throughput by 7.3--11.0% over a Dual Chunk all-gather baseline, with attention forward+backward 24.5--44.9% faster.
papers.comment: Published as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026

papers.title_zh: FlashMask-3：高效且富有表现力的掩模感知分布式注意力
papers.summary_zh: 大语言和多模态模型的长上下文训练将结构化注意掩码（文档、前缀LM、共享问题、滑动窗口、块稀疏）与多节点上下文并行性结合起来，使掩码成为主要瓶颈。 FlashMask 的按列稀疏掩码通过四个查询轴边界向量将它们从 $O(n^2)$ 压缩到 $O(n)$，涵盖广泛的结构化模式。它是为 Ampere GPU 实现的，既不利用 Hopper 上 FlashAttention-3 的 TMA/WGMMA 扭曲专用管道，也不支持分发。按列稀疏掩码按关键位置索引，但存储查询轴间隔边界。在任何多块上下文并行分配下，它将每秩掩码定位减少到边界向量上可证明的零通信 \emph{clip--shift--max} ，与单 GPU 内核兼容。 FlashMask-3 在 FlashAttention-3 的 TMA/WGMMA 管道上引入了具有三角色扭曲专业化的掩码感知 Hopper 内核，以及掩码感知分布式扩展：零通信掩码本地化、稀疏感知负载均衡器 (HCC-IPO) 以及掩码感知计算通信与掩码驱动通信修剪的重叠，其前向全收集使用拓扑感知分层路由。在 4K--128K 环境下跨 12 个掩模的单个 H100 上，它比 FlashMask、FlexAttention 和 MagiAttention 实现的 TFLOP 提高了 45--141%、34--71% 和 2--44%。在每台设备 8K 序列的上下文并行度 4--32 下，它实现了 31--75% 的计算通信重叠效率，并将 Megatron-Core CP 环、Megatron-Core CP all-gather 和 MagiAttention 的吞吐量提高了 $1.80\times$--$3.71\times$、$1.71\times$--$2.92\times$，以及$1.09\times$--$1.46\times$。在 128 个 H100 GPU 上以 128K 进行 118B-A14B MoE 的端到端训练中，与双块全收集基线相比，吞吐量提高了 7.3--11.0%，注意力向前+向后速度提高了 24.5--44.9%。

papers.title: MMTA: Benchmarking Multimodal Temporal Analysis with Time Series, Text, and Vision
papers.summary: Time-series analysis is increasingly studied in multimodal settings, yet most benchmarks pair temporal signals with text or with visualizations derived from the same signal. This leaves open whether multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can integrate time series with real-world visual evidence. We introduce MMTA (multimodal temporal analysis), a benchmark of tri-modal tasks with diverse cross-modal complementarity patterns among time series, text, and vision. MMTA spans nine domains -- robotics, autonomous driving, human action, manufacturing, AR assistance, healthcare, recommendation, finance, and climate -- under video+TS and image+TS layouts, with a 3,524-sample test split covering classification and forecasting. The benchmark standardizes heterogeneous real-world sources into a shared schema with domain-specific prompts, provenance documentation, and success-weighted metrics that penalize both wrong answers and failed generations. Evaluating eight open-source and proprietary MLLMs reveals a shared bottleneck: representing time series as text creates very long token sequences and weakens fine-grained alignment with visual evidence, especially in long-video settings. We then introduce TimeOmni-v, a multimodal LLM extension with a dedicated time-series encoder, temporal positional alignment, modality-aware token layout, and a forecasting head. TimeOmni-v improves long-video classification and time-series inference efficiency, showing that MMTA not only exposes representation and grounding failures but also motivates targeted model design.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Project page: https://windowso.github.io/MMTA/

papers.title_zh: MMTA：使用时间序列、文本和视觉对多模态时间分析进行基准测试
papers.summary_zh: 时间序列分析在多模态设置中得到越来越多的研究，但大多数基准将时间信号与文本或从同一信号派生的可视化配对。这使得多模态大语言模型（MLLM）是否能够将时间序列与现实世界的视觉证据相整合尚不确定。我们引入了 MMTA（多模态时间分析），这是三模态任务的基准，在时间序列、文本和视觉之间具有多种跨模态互补模式。 MMTA 跨越机器人、自动驾驶、人类行为、制造、AR 辅助、医疗保健、推荐、金融和气候九个领域，采用视频+TS 和图像+TS 布局，3,524 个样本测试分割涵盖分类和预测。该基准将异构的现实世界源标准化为一个共享模式，其中包含特定于域的提示、出处文档和成功加权指标，这些指标会惩罚错误的答案和失败的生成。评估八个开源和专有的 MLLM 揭示了一个共同的瓶颈：将时间序列表示为文本会创建非常长的标记序列，并削弱与视觉证据的细粒度对齐，尤其是在长视频设置中。然后，我们介绍 TimeOmni-v，这是一个多模态 LLM 扩展，具有专用时间序列编码器、时间位置对齐、模态感知令牌布局和预测头。 TimeOmni-v 提高了长视频分类和时间序列推理效率，表明 MMTA 不仅暴露了表示和接地故障，而且还激发了有针对性的模型设计。

papers.title: Quota-Based Aging for Prediction-Guided Scheduling in LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) serving systems use token-level continuous batching to improve resource utilization, but heterogeneous response lengths complicate request scheduling. Prediction-guided short-first scheduling reduces average latency but can severely delay long requests, while unrestricted aging may over-promote delayed long requests under congestion. We propose Quota-Based Aging (QBA), a lightweight policy that combines predicted short-first admission with quota-bounded, debt-enforced promotion of aged predicted-long requests. We also use a reduced M/G/n queueing surrogate, calibrated from simulator traces, to explain first-order mean-latency trends. QBA is evaluated using a serving-aware event-driven simulator that models decode-priority batching, chunked prefill, token-budget constraints, and KV-cache-safe admission. We compare QBA with FCFS, predicted short-first, and aggressive aging under asymmetric prediction errors on synthetic and production-derived workloads. The evaluation considers queueing delay, throughput, utilization, and class-conditional tail performance. Results show that QBA provides a controllable middle ground between aggressive short-first prioritization and unrestricted aging, substantially reducing long-request tail latency while retaining much of the mean-latency benefit of prediction-guided scheduling.
papers.comment: 8 pages, 10 figures. Accepted for publication at the 45th IEEE International Performance, Computing, and Communications Conference (IPCCC 2026), Austin, TX, November 2026

papers.title_zh: LLM 服务中预测引导调度的基于配额的老化
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务系统使用令牌级连续批处理来提高资源利用率，但异构响应长度使请求调度变得复杂。预测引导的短优先调度减少了平均延迟，但会严重延迟长请求，而无限制的老化可能会在拥塞情况下过度促进延迟的长请求。我们提出基于配额的时效（QBA），这是一种轻量级策略，它将预测的短优先接纳与对时效的预测长请求的配额限制、债务强制促进相结合。我们还使用根据模拟器轨迹进行校准的简化 M/G/n 排队代理来解释一阶平均延迟趋势。 QBA 使用服务感知事件驱动模拟器进行评估，该模拟器对解码优先级批处理、分块预填充、令牌预算约束和 KV 缓存安全准入进行建模。我们将 QBA 与 FCFS 进行比较，在合成和生产衍生工作负载的不对称预测错误下预测短优先和激进老化。评估考虑了排队延迟、吞吐量、利用率和类条件尾部性能。结果表明，QBA 在积极的短优先优先级和无限制老化之间提供了一个可控的中间立场，大大减少了长请求尾部延迟，同时保留了预测引导调度的大部分平均延迟优势。

papers.title: Foundation Models for Event Prediction Across Heterogeneous Event Logs
papers.summary: Event logs are ubiquitous across real-world domains, including business processes, manufacturing workflows, healthcare, and many other operational systems. Yet event logs can differ substantially in their event semantics, label spaces, interaction patterns, and temporal scales, making it difficult to build a single foundation model that generalizes directly to previously unseen systems. We address this challenge with the Foundation Event Predictor (FEP), a simple and scalable in-context architecture that performs next-event prediction through learned, event-level nonparametric inference. Causal self-attention encodes context and target histories into key and query representations, respectively, while the observed next context events are encoded as values. Cross-attention then performs learned, relevance-weighted aggregation of next-event outcomes over all context transitions, allowing the entire nonparametric prediction procedure to be expressed as standard attention operations and efficiently parallelized with modern kernels such as FlashAttention. To promote cross-system generalization, we introduce permutation-robust embedding learning and random fixed embeddings to decouple event IDs from persistent semantics, together with empirical quantile transforms and robust normalization to handle diverse temporal scales. We pretrain FEP on 696 real-world event datasets spanning heterogeneous event systems and evaluate it on 50 held-out datasets unseen during pretraining. Across these datasets, FEP generalizes effectively to new event systems without parameter adaptation, frequently approaching the performance of strong models trained separately on each target dataset while substantially outperforming existing foundation-model baselines, particularly on challenging prediction tasks.

papers.title_zh: 跨异构事件日志的事件预测的基础模型
papers.summary_zh: 事件日志在现实世界中无处不在，包括业务流程、制造工作流程、医疗保健和许多其他操作系统。然而，事件日志在事件语义、标签空间、交互模式和时间尺度上可能存在很大差异，因此很难构建直接推广到以前未见过的系统的单一基础模型。我们使用基础事件预测器 (FEP) 来应对这一挑战，这是一种简单且可扩展的上下文架构，可通过学习的事件级非参数推理来执行下一个事件预测。因果自注意力将上下文和目标历史分别编码为键和查询表示，而观察到的下一个上下文事件被编码为值。然后，交叉注意力在所有上下文转换上对下一个事件结果执行学习的、相关性加权的聚合，从而允许整个非参数预测过程表示为标准注意力操作，并与 FlashAttention 等现代内核有效并行。为了促进跨系统泛化，我们引入了排列鲁棒嵌入学习和随机固定嵌入，以将事件 ID 与持久语义分离，同时引入经验分位数变换和鲁棒归一化来处理不同的时间尺度。我们在跨异构事件系统的 696 个真实事件数据集上对 FEP 进行预训练，并在预训练期间未见过的 50 个保留数据集上对其进行评估。在这些数据集中，FEP 可以有效地推广到无需参数调整的新事件系统，经常接近在每个目标数据集上单独训练的强大模型的性能，同时大大优于现有的基础模型基线，特别是在具有挑战性的预测任务上。

papers.title: A Scaled-Up Empirical Study of Syntactic Language Models
papers.summary: Syntactic language models (SLMs) that generate sentences along with their syntactic tree structures have shown promise in both syntactic generalization and downstream tasks. Prior studies, however, have mostly evaluated smaller models trained on less pretraining data and tested on narrower task suites. In addition, the design space of tree linearization and attention masks remains underexplored. We conduct a large-scale empirical study of 12 controlled configurations---one terminal baseline and 11 SLM variants spanning different linearizations and masks---at scales up to 1B parameters and 100B training tokens, evaluated across 11 downstream tasks and two syntactic benchmarks. The experimental results show that SLMs with standard causal attention match or exceed structural-mask variants across downstream and syntactic benchmarks. They require no architectural modifications and remain compatible with FlashAttention. We also observe that when scaling up to the 1B-parameter scale, the top-performing SLM variant no longer shows a clear advantage over a compute-matched non-structural baseline, suggesting that SLMs may become less competitive with scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation.

papers.title_zh: 句法语言模型的大规模实证研究
papers.summary_zh: 生成句子及其句法树结构的句法语言模型（SLM）在句法泛化和下游任务中都显示出了前景。然而，之前的研究大多评估了在较少预训练数据上训练的较小模型，并在较窄的任务套件上进行了测试。此外，树线性化和注意力掩模的设计空间仍未得到充分探索。我们对 12 种受控配置（一个终端基线和 11 个跨越不同线性化和掩码的 SLM 变体）进行了大规模实证研究，规模高达 1B 个参数和 100B 个训练标记，并在 11 个下游任务和两个句法基准上进行了评估。实验结果表明，具有标准因果注意力的 SLM 在下游和句法基准上匹配或超过结构掩码变体。它们不需要架构修改并与 FlashAttention 保持兼容。我们还观察到，当扩展到 1B 参数规模时，性能最好的 SLM 变体不再显示出比计算匹配的非结构基线明显的优势，这表明 SLM 可能会随着规模的扩大而变得不那么有竞争力。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/qlwpc/TG-Interpolation 获取。

papers.title: Prorsa: Unleashing the Potential of Prefill-Decode Disaggregation in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly used to enhance the capabilities of large language models (LLMs) in solving complex multi-turn tasks. During rollout, agentic RL exhibits a workload pattern distinct from that of traditional RL: multi-turn interactions repeatedly introduce prefill requests, causing prefill and decode workloads to coexist throughout rollout. This workload makes prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation, a design widely used for online LLM serving, promising for speeding up agentic RL rollout. This paper shows that PD disaggregation can improve rollout efficiency by (a) mitigating interference among data-parallel attention modules, (b) enabling stage-specific parallelism, and (c) reducing end-to-end trajectory completion time. However, a fixed prefill-decode allocation may fail to sustain these benefits as workload composition varies across tasks and over time. We therefore present Prorsa, an agentic RL framework for prediction-guided prefill-decode resource allocation. Prorsa observes the lifecycle of every trajectory to forecast short-horizon prefill and decode demand. These forecasts then guide worker allocation decisions and trigger role switching of rollout engines, aligning prefill and decode capacity with anticipated workload demand. Across synchronous and asynchronous agentic RL settings, Prorsa achieves end-to-end rollout speedups of 1.11x-4.05x over prefill-decode colocation.

papers.title_zh: Prorsa：释放代理强化学习中预填充解码分解的潜力
papers.summary_zh: 代理强化学习（RL）通常用于增强大型语言模型（LLM）解决复杂多轮任务的能力。在推出期间，代理强化学习表现出与传统强化学习不同的工作负载模式：多轮交互重复引入预填充请求，导致预填充和解码工作负载在整个推出过程中共存。这种工作负载使得预填充解码 (PD) 分解成为一种广泛用于在线 LLM 服务的设计，有望加速代理 RL 的推出。本文表明，PD 分解可以通过以下方式提高推出效率：(a) 减轻数据并行注意模块之间的干扰，(b) 实现阶段特定的并行性，以及 (c) 减少端到端轨迹完成时间。然而，固定的预填充解码分配可能无法维持这些优势，因为工作负载组成随任务和时间的推移而变化。因此，我们提出了 Prorsa，一种用于预测引导的预填充解码资源分配的代理强化学习框架。 Prorsa 观察每个轨迹的生命周期，以预测短期预填充和解码需求。然后，这些预测指导工作人员分配决策并触发部署引擎的角色切换，使预填充和解码容量与预期工作负载需求保持一致。在同步和异步代理 RL 设置中，Prorsa 的端到端部署速度比预填充解码托管提高了 1.11 倍至 4.05 倍。

papers.title: LoopQuant: Accurate and Efficient Post-Training Quantization for Looped Transformers
papers.summary: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) improve parameter efficiency by recursively reusing shared Transformer modules, yet their repeated computation over evolving recurrent states poses new challenges for low-bit deployment. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods, largely designed for feed-forward Transformers, fail to account for cross-loop activation dynamics, heterogeneous loop sensitivity, and recursive error propagation, leading to substantial performance degradation at low precision. To address these challenges, we propose LoopQuant, a loop-aware PTQ framework for accurate and efficient low-bit quantization of LoopLMs. LoopQuant is built on three core components: 1) Cross-Loop Distribution Canonicalization (CLDC) learns a shared quantization-friendly representation across recurrent states while preserving parameter sharing; 2) Interaction-Aware Loop-wise Precision Allocation (ILPA) allocates activation precision under a fixed bit budget by modeling task-level loop sensitivity and cross-loop interactions; and 3) Loop-Conditioned Task Calibration (LCTC) further aligns quantized inference with the low-bit recursive trajectory through lightweight task-space calibration. Extensive experiments across LoopLM architectures demonstrate that LoopQuant consistently outperforms existing low-bit PTQ methods. On Ouro-2.6B, LoopQuant under W4A4 surpasses all W4A8 baselines in performance, while reducing model memory by 65.3% with only 3.4% additional storage overhead over naive INT4 and achieving a 1.7 times decoding speedup over BF16. These results demonstrate a strong balance among accuracy, compression, and inference efficiency, providing a practical and deployment-friendly solution for low-bit LoopLM inference. The code is available at [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant].

papers.title_zh: LoopQuant：环形变压器准确高效的训练后量化
papers.summary_zh: 循环语言模型 (LoopLM) 通过递归地重用共享 Transformer 模块来提高参数效率，但它们对不断演变的循环状态的重复计算给低位部署带来了新的挑战。现有的训练后量化（PTQ）方法主要是为前馈 Transformer 设计的，无法考虑跨环激活动态、异构环灵敏度和递归误差传播，导致低精度下性能大幅下降。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 LoopQuant，这是一种循环感知 PTQ 框架，用于对 LoopLM 进行准确且高效的低位量化。 LoopQuant 基于三个核心组件构建：1）跨循环分布规范化（CLDC）在保留参数共享的同时学习跨循环状态的共享量化友好表示； 2）交互感知循环精度分配（ILPA）通过对任务级循环敏感性和跨循环交互进行建模，在固定比特预算下分配激活精度； 3）循环条件任务校准（LCTC）通过轻量级任务空间校准进一步将量化推理与低位递归轨迹对齐。跨 LoopLM 架构的大量实验表明，LoopQuant 始终优于现有的低位 PTQ 方法。在 Ouro-2.6B 上，W4A4 下的 LoopQuant 在性能上超越了所有 W4A8 基准，同时将模型内存减少了 65.3%，仅比 naive INT4 增加了 3.4% 的额外存储开销，并实现了比 BF16 1.7 倍的解码加速。这些结果展示了准确性、压缩和推理效率之间的强大平衡，为低位 LoopLM 推理提供了实用且易于部署的解决方案。该代码可在 [https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/LoopQuant] 获取。

papers.title: Hashrope: A Persistent Data Structure for Mechanisms of LLM Context Management
papers.summary: Serving stacks for large language models manage context through four recurring mechanisms: incremental edits to a growing context, branching and snapshotting for tree search, identification of reusable prefixes for KV-cache reuse, and encoding of repeated segments. Each mechanism is served today by a different specialist structure. We show that all four reduce to a single persistent weight-balanced rope whose every node carries a polynomial hash of its subtree over a Mersenne prime, so that the structure supports logarithmic edits and logarithmic verified content-identity queries at the same time. We validate each mechanism with pre-registered, replicated experiments, then compare against a deployed specialist per mechanism: the Ropey editing library, a faithful PagedAttention copy-on-write block table, and the vendored SGLang radix matcher. On workloads that interleave edits with identity queries, Hashrope is net-superior to Ropey by a factor that grows without bound (369.7x at one million characters). Against the radix matcher on a live vLLM stack serving Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M on four A100 GPUs, Hashrope identifies a one-million-token shared prefix exactly and 1.20x faster, at a context length the dense engine cannot even prefill.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，但证据链尚不足顶会强录。
pros: 将编辑、分支、前缀匹配与重复编码统一到同一持久结构，建模视角新颖
给出与真实系统组件对比并在vLLM实栈展示收益，工程相关性较强
cons: 摘要中“无界增长优势”等表述偏激进，缺少复杂度常数、最坏情形与失败案例说明
评测覆盖面仍有限：跨模型/负载分布/并发度与内存开销权衡未充分展开

papers.title_zh: Hashrope：LLM上下文管理机制的持久数据结构
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型的服务堆栈通过四种重复机制来管理上下文：对不断增长的上下文进行增量编辑、用于树搜索的分支和快照、识别用于 KV 缓存重用的可重用前缀以及对重复片段进行编码。如今，每个机制都由不同的专业结构提供服务。我们证明，所有四个都简化为单个持久的权重平衡绳，其每个节点都在梅森素数上携带其子树的多项式哈希，因此该结构同时支持对数编辑和对数验证的内容身份查询。我们通过预先注册、重复的实验来验证每种机制，然后与每种机制的部署专家进行比较：Ropey 编辑库、忠实的 PagedAttention 写时复制块表以及供应的 SGLang 基数匹配器。在编辑与身份查询交错的工作负载上，Hashrope 的净优于 Ropey 的程度无限增长（100 万个字符时为 369.7 倍）。与在四个 A100 GPU 上提供 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M 的实时 vLLM 堆栈上的基数匹配器相比，Hashrope 准确地识别了一百万个令牌共享前缀，并且速度提高了 1.20 倍，而上下文长度是密集引擎甚至无法预填充的。

papers.title: Lightweight Scheduling Policies for Continuously Batched LLM Serving Across GPU Architectures
papers.summary: Large language model serving is increasingly limited not only by model size and GPU speed, but also by scheduling during autoregressive decoding, where continuous batching interleaves requests at token granularity as sequences arrive and finish. We study whether lightweight scheduling policies can improve latency-throughput tradeoffs without changing model architectures, kernels, or deploying learned schedulers. We implement a Python/PyTorch continuous-batching testbench with real Hugging Face execution and evaluate eight policies across 1,152 GPU-model-scheduler-workload runs using ShareGPT-derived traffic, six Qwen, Gemma, and Mistral models, and Modal L40S, A100, and H100 GPUs. Scheduler choice changes throughput, TTFT, completion latency, and tail behavior under fixed model, GPU, workload, batch size, and prefill budget. Aging shortest-prompt-first is the strongest practical baseline in many L40S and mixed-workload settings, while oracle remaining-length scheduling shows that job-size knowledge alone is insufficient because batching and hardware effects also shape performance. The custom dataset has been uploaded to Hugging Face.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值较实在，但方法创新性有限。
pros: 问题定位准确，聚焦连续批处理调度这一关键系统瓶颈
实验覆盖模型、GPU与负载组合较全面，结论具备较强实证参考价值

仅基于Python/PyTorch测试平台，和生产级serving栈的一致性与可迁移性仍有风险

papers.title_zh: 跨 GPU 架构连续批处理 LLLM 服务的轻量级调度策略
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型服务不仅受到模型大小和 GPU 速度的限制，而且还受到自回归解码期间调度的限制，其中连续批处理在序列到达和完成时以令牌粒度交错请求。我们研究轻量级调度策略是否可以在不改变模型架构、内核或部署学习调度器的情况下改善延迟-吞吐量权衡。我们实现了具有真实 Hugging Face 执行的 Python/PyTorch 连续批处理测试平台，并使用 ShareGPT 派生流量、六个 Qwen、Gemma 和 Mistral 模型以及 Modal L40S、A100 和 H100 GPU 评估了 1,152 个 GPU 模型调度程序工作负载运行中的 8 个策略。调度程序的选择会改变固定模型、GPU、工作负载、批量大小和预填充预算下的吞吐量、TTFT、完成延迟和尾部行为。在许多 L40S 和混合工作负载设置中，老化最短提示优先是最强的实用基线，而 Oracle 剩余长度调度表明，仅了解作业大小是不够的，因为批处理和硬件影响也会影响性能。自定义数据集已上传至 Hugging Face。

papers.title: Native Dual Pools or Shared Paging? Memory Organization for Concurrent Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.summary: Hybrid attention-SSM serving combines growing attention KV with fixed-size recurrent and convolution state whose allocation units, reuse boundaries, and lifetimes differ. We implement four memory organizations in a modified vLLM runtime: a coarse shared-page baseline (S0), checkpoint-internal recurrent paging (S1), paging with convolution-slot packing (S2), and native dual pools (D0). Nine evaluation questions cover storage costs and serving behavior. The cumulative S0-S1-S2 refinement improves completed-output throughput and tail completion time at the main operating point. D0-S2 performance varies with memory budget, offered load, and admission headroom. Shared-prefix workloads yield larger stepwise gains; gains also persist in a no-sharing control with equal recorded input-work totals. State traces identify recurrent-checkpoint availability as the limit on joint reuse in the tested S2 runs. Extending producer-side checkpoint lifetime increases reusable depth at a fixed page budget. A fresh-seed SHARE/ISOLATE comparison estimates a positive retention interaction, with a primary confidence interval that includes zero. Retained-state continuation correctness remains unresolved. These findings motivate evaluating physical state representation together with request admission and checkpoint lifetime when designing memory management for concurrent hybrid-model serving.
papers.comment: 10 pages of main text, 31 pages of supplementary appendices. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 工程实证扎实，但核心结论统计与正确性仍偏弱。
pros: 围绕混合注意力-SSM并发服务提出了系统化内存组织对比，问题定义贴近实践
在修改版vLLM中实现四种方案并给出多维评测，揭示了检查点生命周期与准入的关键作用
cons: 关键收益在部分设置下不稳定且置信区间含零，统计说服力有限

papers.title_zh: 本机双池还是共享分页？并发混合 LLM 服务的内存组织
papers.summary_zh: 混合注意力 SSM 服务将不断增长的注意力 KV 与固定大小的循环和卷积状态相结合，其分配单元、重用边界和生命周期不同。我们在修改后的 vLLM 运行时中实现了四种内存组织：粗略共享页面基线 (S0)、检查点内部循环分页 (S1)、带卷积时隙打包的分页 (S2) 和本机双池 (D0)。九个评估问题涵盖存储成本和服务行为。累积的 S0-S1-S2 细化提高了主操作点的完成输出吞吐量和尾部完成时间。 D0-S2 性能随内存预算、提供的负载和准入余量而变化。共享前缀工作负载会产生更大的逐步增益；在具有相同记录的投入工作总量的无共享控制中，收益也持续存在。状态跟踪将循环检查点可用性识别为测试的 S2 运行中联合重用的限制。延长生产者端检查点的生命周期可以在固定页面预算的情况下增加可重用深度。新鲜种子共享/分离比较估计正保留交互作用，主要置信区间包括零。保留状态延续的正确性仍未解决。这些发现促使在设计并发混合模型服务的内存管理时评估物理状态表示以及请求准入和检查点生命周期。

papers.title: Drift, Then Spread: Learning One-Step Generative Policies for Online Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Generative policies offer expressive action distributions for online reinforcement learning (RL), but many diffusion- and flow-based policies require costly iterative sampling. We propose DriftSpread, a one-step generative policy based on Drifting for online maximum-entropy (MaxEnt) RL. To incorporate entropy without a tractable policy density, we build on an energy-based view of Drifting and derive critic-guided Drift and entropy-induced Spread from the negative MaxEnt objective. Our method learns these updates sequentially in the same actor, using action regression for value improvement and distribution matching to capture the effect of entropy. The actor updates require neither direct samples from the critic-defined Boltzmann target nor policy-density or score estimation. Under exact fitting with a fixed critic, we prove convergence to the Boltzmann target in the small-step limit followed by the long-time limit. On MuJoCo, DriftSpread achieves the highest aggregate normalized return among all evaluated methods, while outperforming the diffusion- and flow-based baselines in both training and inference efficiency.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且实用，但理论与泛化验证仍需加强。
pros: 提出一步采样生成策略，直击扩散/流策略在线RL推理开销痛点
将MaxEnt目标拆为Drift与Spread并在单一actor顺序学习，方法设计简洁
cons: 理论结论依赖固定critic与极限条件，现实训练下可达性和稳健性证据不足
实验主要在MuJoCo，缺少更复杂任务与更广泛消融来支撑普适价值

papers.title_zh: 漂移，然后传播：学习在线强化学习的一步生成策略
papers.summary_zh: 生成策略为在线强化学习（RL）提供了表达性的动作分布，但许多基于扩散和流的策略需要昂贵的迭代采样。我们提出了 DriftSpread，这是一种基于在线最大熵 (MaxEnt) RL 漂移的一步生成策略。为了在没有易于处理的政策密度的情况下纳入熵，我们建立在基于能量的漂移视图上，并从负 MaxEnt 目标中导出评论家引导的漂移和熵诱导的扩散。我们的方法在同一参与者中顺序学习这些更新，使用动作回归进行价值改进和分布匹配以捕获熵的影响。参与者更新既不需要来自批评者定义的玻尔兹曼目标的直接样本，也不需要策略密度或分数估计。在与固定批评家的精确拟合下，我们证明了在小步极限和长时间极限下收敛到玻尔兹曼目标。在 MuJoCo 上，DriftSpread 在所有评估方法中实现了最高的总归一化回报，同时在训练和推理效率方面优于基于扩散和基于流的基线。

papers.title: The Price of Precision: A Calibrated Cost Model for Mixed-Precision LLM Serving
papers.summary: Choosing a mixed-precision configuration for large language model (LLM) serving trades speed against accuracy. Allocators that use average bit-width or a memory budget as a speed proxy can miss changes in the resource that limits execution. We argue that served speed can be limited by compute, weight loading, or key-value (KV) cache access, depending on the phase, batch size, and context length. A byte-based proxy does not capture all of these costs, so fewer bits do not always mean faster serving. To address this gap, we build a cost model that accounts for the binding resource and use it in two ways. First, as a predictor: given a configuration and operating point, it estimates serving latency using constants calibrated for the model, GPU, and serving stack. We evaluate its accuracy across three hardware classes. Second, as an allocator: we combine modeled time costs with measured per-tensor accuracy costs and use a dynamic program to select a configuration under a latency or accuracy budget. We compare its configurations against byte-aware and sensitivity-only allocation.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要且方案务实，但创新与证据深度中等。
pros: 抓住混合精度中“瓶颈资源切换”这一关键失配点，问题定义准确
将可校准时延模型与精度代价结合做分配，方法闭环且具工程可落地性
cons: 创新更偏系统化整合而非机制突破，校准开销与跨模型/栈泛化风险仍待更强证据
摘要未体现对长尾时延、在线负载波动和多租户场景的充分验证

papers.title_zh: 精度的代价：混合精度 LLM 服务的校准成本模型
papers.summary_zh: 为大型语言模型 (LLM) 服务选择混合精度配置会影响速度和准确性。使用平均位宽或内存预算作为速度代理的分配器可能会错过限制执行的资源变化。我们认为，服务速度可能会受到计算、权重加载或键值 (KV) 缓存访问的限制，具体取决于阶段、批量大小和上下文长度。基于字节的代理无法捕获所有这些成本，因此更少的位并不总是意味着更快的服务。为了解决这一差距，我们构建了一个成本模型来解释绑定资源并以两种方式使用它。首先，作为预测器：给定配置和操作点，它使用为模型、GPU 和服务堆栈校准的常数来估计服务延迟。我们评估了三个硬件类别的准确性。其次，作为分配器：我们将建模的时间成本与测量的每个张量的准确性成本结合起来，并使用动态程序在延迟或准确性预算下选择配置。我们将其配置与字节感知和仅敏感度分配进行比较。

papers.title: SpecFit: Not All Draft Tokens Cost the Same in Offloaded MoE Inference
papers.summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models activate only a few experts per token, but when their expert weights are offloaded to host memory, host-to-device (H2D) expert transfers enter the critical path of decoding. Speculative decoding verifies several draft tokens in one forward pass, yet in an MoE model each verified token activates its own experts, so a larger draft tree transfers more experts. Because of this H2D cost, speculative decoding commits several tokens per verification cycle yet is sometimes even slower than autoregressive decoding. Based on this observation, we propose SpecFit, which chooses the verified draft subtree to maximize predicted throughput rather than acceptance length. SpecFit estimates the expected number of committed tokens from draft path probabilities and predicts cycle time from the node count and the per-layer union of the experts the subtree activates; this union is a monotone submodular coverage function, so each node pays only for the experts it adds. An exact search over ancestor-closed subtrees returns the subtree with the highest predicted throughput; run after each draft level, the same search also decides when to stop drafting, and the unmodified target verifies the result. On CNN/DailyMail summarization and a GSM8K subset with Qwen3-30B-A3B, SpecFit decodes 21.6% and 7.0% faster than EAGLE-3 with the same expert cache and 1.97x and 1.72x as fast as vanilla EAGLE-3. Code is available at https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题抓得准且方法有新意，但实证广度仍不足。
pros: 提出以吞吐量而非接受长度优化子树，直击MoE卸载瓶颈
将专家并集建模为单调子模覆盖，代价分解清晰且可精确搜索
cons: 评测范围较窄且增益不稳定（任务间差距大），泛化与鲁棒性证据不足
缺少与更多强基线和不同硬件/模型规模的系统对比，外部有效性有限

papers.title_zh: SpecFit：在卸载的 MoE 推理中，并非所有草案代币的成本都相同
papers.summary_zh: 专家混合（MoE）模型每个代币仅激活少数专家，但是当它们的专家权重被卸载到主机内存时，主机到设备（H2D）专家传输进入解码的关键路径。推测性解码会在一次前向传递中验证多个草稿令牌，但在 MoE 模型中，每个经过验证的令牌都会激活自己的专家，因此较大的草稿树会传输更多专家。由于这种 H2D 成本，推测解码在每个验证周期提交多个令牌，但有时甚至比自回归解码更慢。基于这一观察，我们提出了 SpecFit，它选择经过验证的草案子树来最大化预测吞吐量而不是接受长度。 SpecFit 根据草案路径概率估计提交令牌的预期数量，并根据节点数和子树激活的专家的每层并集预测周期时间；该联合是一个单调子模覆盖函数，因此每个节点只需为其添加的专家付费。对祖先封闭子树的精确搜索返回具有最高预测吞吐量的子树；在每个草稿级别之后运行，相同的搜索还决定何时停止草稿，并且未修改的目标验证结果。在 CNN/DailyMail 摘要和带有 Qwen3-30B-A3B 的 GSM8K 子集上，SpecFit 的解码速度比具有相同专家缓存的 EAGLE-3 快 21.6% 和 7.0%，比普通 EAGLE-3 快 1.97 倍和 1.72 倍。代码可在 https://github.com/Chlience/SpecFit 获取。

papers.title: Accelerating Cross-Model LLM Inference via Attention Map Reuse
papers.summary: LLM-augmented data workflows often involve multiple heterogeneous models operating over substantial shared context, such as schemas, tool specifications, interaction history, and intermediate results. Although prefix caching can reduce prefilling overhead, existing approaches are largely limited to reuse within the same model because KV states are tightly coupled to model-specific architectures. We present MapFlow, a system for efficient heterogeneous LLM serving via cross-model attention map reuse. Instead of reusing KV states, MapFlow reuses attention maps, which capture token dependency patterns and are more transferable across models. To enable efficient and accurate reuse, we combine partial recomputation with lightweight linear translation across layers and heads. To make attention reuse practical for long contexts, we further introduce block-level sparse compression and a fused retrieval kernel. Experiments show that MapFlow reduces prefilling latency and improves end-to-end serving efficiency while preserving generation quality across heterogeneous model pairs and multi-turn routing workloads. These results suggest that attention maps provide an effective reusable state for heterogeneous LLM serving, especially in prefix-heavy data workflows. Our code is available: https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 选题有价值且思路新颖，但证据仍偏系统实证。
pros: 提出跨模型复用 attention map，绕开 KV 强模型耦合痛点
兼顾算法与系统实现（部分重算、压缩与融合检索核）并面向长上下文场景

收益可能依赖特定模型配对与前缀重用分布，泛化到更异构架构存在风险

papers.title_zh: 通过注意力图重用加速跨模型 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: LLM 增强数据工作流程通常涉及在大量共享上下文（例如模式、工具规范、交互历史记录和中间结果）上运行的多个异构模型。尽管前缀缓存可以减少预填充开销，但现有方法很大程度上仅限于在同一模型中重用，因为 KV 状态与特定于模型的架构紧密耦合。我们提出了 MapFlow，这是一个通过跨模型注意力图重用提供高效异构 LLM 服务的系统。 MapFlow 没有重复使用 KV 状态，而是重复使用注意力图，它捕获标记依赖模式并且更容易跨模型转移。为了实现高效、准确的重用，我们将部分重新计算与跨层和头的轻量级线性平移相结合。为了使注意力重用在长上下文中实用，我们进一步引入了块级稀疏压缩和融合检索内核。实验表明，MapFlow 减少了预填充延迟并提高了端到端服务效率，同时保持了异构模型对和多轮路由工作负载的生成质量。这些结果表明，注意力图为异构 LLM 服务提供了有效的可重用状态，尤其是在前缀较多的数据工作流程中。我们的代码可用：https://github.com/PKU-DAIR/MapFlow。

papers.title: Vesta: Queueing-Aware LLM Scheduling for Real-World Workloads
papers.summary: Agentic applications generate multi-turn sequences of LLM requests, with each new turn extending the context accumulated from prior interactions and tool calls. Prefix caching reuses the KV cache of earlier turns and avoids redundant prefill, but routing every turn to its cache-affine instance can create severe local queues while capacity remains idle elsewhere. Remote KV cache access relaxes this tension, yet migrating execution adds transfer work and is harmful when the cluster is already congested. Thus, deciding where to execute a request requires reasoning jointly about cache locality, queueing, and the current operating point of the cluster. We present Vesta, a queueing-aware scheduler for distributed agentic LLM serving. Vesta assigns each session a stable holder for its authoritative KV cache while independently selecting an executor for every request. Grounded in classical queueing theory, its objective accounts for backlog, reusable prefixes, KV cache transfer, and the queueing externality of additional service demand; it migrates execution to recover idle capacity when beneficial and favors placements that add the least prefill and transfer work as congestion rises. Vesta also migrates reusable prefixes across length buckets to avoid cold starts. On real-world agentic workloads, Vesta improves throughput by 14.0\% and reduces mean TTFT by 57.8\% over the state-of-the-art scheduler in a PD-colocated deployment. In PD-disaggregated deployments, it reduces mean TTFT by up to 18.1\% and P99 TTFT by up to 29.0\% at matched throughput.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但验证细节待审
pros: 将缓存亲和、排队与迁移开销统一建模，问题定义精准
在真实 agentic 负载下报告了显著 TTFT 与吞吐收益，工程价值高
cons: 摘要未交代理论假设、稳定性边界与统计显著性，严谨性与泛化风险仍需正文证实

papers.title_zh: Vesta：针对实际工作负载的队列感知 LLM 调度
papers.summary_zh: 代理应用程序生成 LLM 请求的多轮序列，每个新轮次都会扩展从先前交互和工具调用中积累的上下文。前缀缓存重用早期轮次的 KV 缓存并避免冗余预填充，但将每个轮次路由到其缓存仿射实例可能会创建严重的本地队列，而其他地方的容量仍处于闲置状态。远程 KV 缓存访问缓解了这种压力，但迁移执行会增加传输工作，并且在集群已经拥塞时是有害的。因此，决定在哪里执行请求需要联合推理缓存位置、队列和集群的当前操作点。我们推出了 Vesta，一个用于分布式代理 LLM 服务的队列感知调度程序。 Vesta 为每个会话分配一个稳定的持有者来保存其权威的 KV 缓存，同时为每个请求独立选择一个执行器。基于经典排队理论，其目标考虑了积压、可重用前缀、KV 缓存传输以及额外服务需求的排队外部性；它会在有利时迁移执行以恢复闲置容量，并有利于在拥塞加剧时增加最少预填充和传输工作的布局。 Vesta 还跨长度桶迁移可重用前缀，以避免冷启动。在现实世界的代理工作负载上，与 PD 共置部署中最先进的调度程序相比，Vesta 将吞吐量提高了 14.0%，并将平均 TTFT 降低了 57.8%。在 PD 分解部署中，在匹配的吞吐量下，它可将平均 TTFT 降低高达 18.1%，将 P99 TTFT 降低高达 29.0%。
